jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Radiopharmaceuticals - EMEA
jobs.description:
Senior Project Manager

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who has expertise within Radiopharmaceuticals ideally Radio Ligland Therapy ( RLT ) to join a team working within life changing precision cancer research. As a Senior Clinical Project Manager at ICON, you will be responsible for leading and managing cross functional projects, ensuring successful execution and delivery of project objectives, including those supporting radiopharmaceutical and radioligand-based clinical programs.

What You Will Do

You will manage day-to-day project and program management activities, supporting your team to deliver quality outcomes across EMEA working as a wider global team.

Key Responsibilities Include

Developing and executing clinical project plans, focusing on achieving project goals and objectives, including those for radiopharmaceutical and radioligand studies with specialized operational requirements.
Leading cross-functional teams to ensure the successful implementation of project activities.
Collaborating with stakeholders to identify project requirements and define project scope.
Mentoring and guiding team members, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.
Driving the development of project documentation and reports to present findings to stakeholders in a clear and actionable manner.
Staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, including advancements in precision medicine, radiopharmaceuticals, and targeted oncology therapies, to integrate best practices into project management strategies.
Contributing to organizational growth through effective project leadership and strategic planning.

Your Profile

You will have solid clinical project and program management experience, with the ability to manage competing priorities and develop your team. Required qualifications and experience:

Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific discipline or healthcare-related field.
Experience in radiopharmaceuticals, or radioligand therapies is required.
Extensive experience in project management, with a proven track record of leading successful projects in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry
Strong proficiency in project management tools and methodologies, with excellent attention to detail.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to develop effective project strategies.
Demonstrated leadership skills, with experience in managing and mentoring teams effectively.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to diverse audiences.
Detail-oriented, with strong organizational skills to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a dynamic environment.
Willingness to travel as required (approximately 25%).

What ICON Can Offer You

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.

Our Benefits Examples Include

Various annual leave entitlements
A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs.
Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being.
Life assurance
Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

At ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know or submit a request here

Interested in the role, but unsure if you meet all of the requirements? We would encourage you to apply regardless – there’s every chance you’re exactly what we’re looking for here at ICON whether it is for this or other roles.

jobs.description:
Senior Project Manager | Structural Steel Fabrication & Erection

Whitmore Steel (WSI) | San Diego, CA | Remote / Hybrid / On-site

$125,000–$155,000 annually | Full-time

Lead the projects. Own the results. Help shape what's next.

Whitmore Steel is an AISC-certified structural steel fabricator and erector based in San Diego, California. We deliver complex commercial, healthcare, industrial, and public works projects, working with leading general contractors and self-performing erection with our own crews.
We're looking for an experienced Structural Steel Project Manager
who understands the business from detailing and fabrication through field erection, takes ownership of results, and knows how to keep projects moving.
This is an opportunity to work directly with company leadership, take on meaningful responsibility, and help shape the next stage of WSI's growth.

What You'll Own

Project delivery:
Lead structural steel projects from detailing and procurement through fabrication, erection, and closeout.
Financial performance:
Own budgets, schedules, forecasting, change orders, and project profitability.
Team coordination:
Work directly with GCs, engineers, detailers, shop personnel, and field crews.
Problem-solving:
Anticipate challenges, drive solutions, and take responsibility for outcomes.
Continuous improvement:
Help strengthen project delivery processes, support other PMs, and contribute to preconstruction efforts.

What You Bring

7+ years of structural steel project management experience preferred. Proven project ownership and results matter more than years alone.
Strong understanding of steel detailing, fabrication, erection sequencing, and construction coordination.
Proven ability to manage project financials, schedules, and client relationships.
A practical, proactive approach with sound judgment, strong communication, and a sense of ownership.

Experience with Tekla PowerFab, design-assist, or technically demanding projects is a plus.

We also welcome accomplished Project Managers who are ready to step into a senior role.

Why WSI?

At WSI, you'll have the autonomy to manage projects, direct access to leadership, and the opportunity to influence how the company operates and grows.

** For the right individual, this position offers a potential career path toward Director of Operations
.

Location & Flexibility

We're open to qualified candidates nationwide. Remote, hybrid, and on-site arrangements are available based on experience and the needs of the role.

Travel to our San Diego facility and project sites will be required as needed for coordination, key project milestones, and team engagement.

Compensation:
$125,000–$155,000 annually, based on experience, plus company benefits.

Interested?

Send your resume to jobs@wsisteel.com
or apply directly.

We'd welcome a conversation about the structural steel projects you've managed and what you're looking for in your next opportunity.

jobs.title: Lead Project Manager 2 – Nuclear
jobs.description:
Significant growth in Sargent & Lundy’s (S&L) business over the past few years has driven the need to increase focus and investment in S&L’s Project Management team. This team works closely with our external clients to handle every detail of their needs, as well as with our internal teams to make the projects run as seamlessly as possible.

The Project Manager will work as a design / construction subject matter expert, responsible for directing team activities and participating in critical evaluations to support new and facility upgrade designs. The PM will s erve as the primary liaison between clients, subcontractors, vendors, and internal teams to ensure alignment on project objectives and requirements. The PM focuses on managing and guiding the team to safely complete the scope of work on schedule and within budget for our clients. We are seeking a proven leader with medium to large scale nuclear power plant experience, who can not only ensure the delivery of essential core services through a design / construction lens but do so with the highest level of alignment with our core values.

Key Responsibilities

Lead medium to large, multi-discipline nuclear projects from early planning and design through implementation, commissioning, turnover, and closeout.
Coordinate with lead managers, discipline leads, and project teams across business units to ensure alignment on technical scope, priorities, and deliverables.
Manage client relationships and expectations; provide timely progress, risk, and cost updates; lead regular performance and status review meetings.
Own project scope, schedule (integrated master schedule with phasing and lookaheads), budget/forecasts, and key performance metrics; maintain project baselines and critical path.
Manage client expectations and maintain strong client relationships through effective communication and timely updates.
Provide oversight to the project’s overall cost and schedule.
Oversee and manage change orders, ensuring scope changes are documented, approved, and incorporated into project plans.
Assess and mitigate the impact of scope changes on cost and schedule.
Develop project-specific Design, Project Management and/or commissioning management work plans.
Perform Home office or remote design, construction planning work before field mobilization.
Lead and manage the design staff.
Monitor overall design, construction and commissioning progress, cost, quality, scope, and safety.
Conduct thorough risk assessments at all stages of the project and develop contingency plans to mitigate construction and commissioning risks.
Report task progress and cost to the Project Manager, Project Director and/or Client.
Lead and attend design project performance review meetings.
Plan Project process by developing schedules, phasing, and lookaheads.
Keep track of project progress and maintain schedules.
Keep all documentation up to date for internal and external project members.
Collaborate with the internal design, construction team, engineers, subcontractors, etc. to determine project needs.
Review and oversee contractual agreements with subcontractors and suppliers to ensure terms and deliverables are met.
Handle disputes or claims arising from contract performance.
Adhere to estimated costs and ensure the project is on budget (and is profitable).
Supervise field staff and provide constructive feedback.
Resolve on-site issues and emergencies.
Oversee project close-out activities, including final inspections, punch list resolution, and documentation handover.
Conduct post-project reviews to capture lessons learned and improve future project execution.
Ensure the job site remains safe, clean, and orderly through compliance S&L standards.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential Skills

Bachelor’s degree in a related field from an accredited college or university, or other relevant field / Operations Experience, Operations Certification and industry experience.
12+ years of progressively responsible experience in the nuclear industry with at least 5 years managing multiple projects or leading a team . Focus will be on full design and/or construction experience.
Must have experience with nuclear projects.
Project Management Professional Certification (PMP) is a plus.
Experience with EPC and GC contract models.
8 to 10+ years in progressive leadership roles, supervising design, Operations and/or construction teams, managing clients, subcontractors, and vendors.
Demonstrated ability to communicate intentionally and clearly across multiple stakeholders, vendors, teammates, and business partners.
Determination of staff positions and size; interviewing and selection of personnel experience.
Experience in establishing and effectively using project controls tools to manage a large construction project.
Understanding of a process approach to accomplishing Project Management and start-up testing work.
Proficient in developing / reviewing Facility Upgrades (e.g., Major and Minor Modifications) to Nuclear Power Plants.
Understand, experienced and familiar with Nuclear Plant Operations (preferably AP1000 Plant Operations)
Understand, experienced and familiar with Nuclear industry Standard Design Process (SDP)
Demonstrated client relationship-building experience.
Knowledge of quality, safety, and health guidelines for sizeable industrial construction job sites.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
Organizational and time-management skills.
Must be able to travel.
Key skills will be Project governance, scheduling, cost management, risk/issue tracking, vendor management, process improvement, team leadership, stakeholder communication, Project Management and organizational alignment.

Technology & Innovation

Sargent & Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work.

We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology-assisted tools.

Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description.

At Sargent & Lundy, we care about the health and well-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. We understand the importance of work-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award-winning benefits. jobs.description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet The Team

Our Program Management team is focused on driving business transformations to support and enable organizational efficiency and growth. We are currently seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to join our team and lead strategic cross-functional projects and initiatives in the EMEA region. If you are interested in being a part of a forward-thinking and growth-oriented organization, and if you possess the skills and experience, we are looking for, we encourage you to consider joining our team. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on business operations in the EMEA region and contribute to the overall success of our organization.

Where You Come In

You will lead strategic regional and global projects and initiatives.
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive project success.
You will be an active member of the project management community in the EMEA and APAC regions.
You will collaborate with business and functional partners to define project/program requirements.
You will develop and implement an execution plan based on the project’s scope, timeline, and available resources.
You will support the execution team in resolving roadblocks and managing interdependencies.
You will communicate effectively with stakeholders and provide regular progress updates.
You will ensure deliverables meet quality standards and stakeholder expectations.
You will track project outcomes and measure stakeholder satisfaction using established metrics and service levels.
You will contribute to advancing PMO maturity by strengthening project management standards, leveraging digital tools, promoting best practices, and mentoring less experienced project managers to enhance delivery consistency, capability growth, and decision-making.

What Makes You Successful

You manage stakeholders effectively.
You demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, clearly communicate your insights, evaluate information and data to make informed decisions, anticipate obstacles, and develop actionable plans to resolve issues.
You maintain a strong customer service orientation.
You embrace change with a proactive mindset, consistently generate process improvements, lead change initiatives, approach challenges creatively, balance multiple and competing priorities, and execute tasks with precision.
You hold (or are working toward) PMP, PRINCE2, or related Project/Program Management certifications.

What You'll Get

A comprehensive onboarding and training on the job.
Opportunity to work in a diverse and inclusive environment with colleagues representing 45 different nationalities.
Hybrid working model, offering the flexibility to work both remotely and in a modern, well-equipped office space.
5 additional vacation days, with potential for more for parents, students, and other cases with approval.
Opportunity to work from other countries for up to 30 days per year.
Health Insurance including reduced premiums available for dependents.
Life and Accident insurance coverage.
3rd Pillar Private Pension plan.
Health and Wellness programs, including access to online coaching and therapy sessions
Fertility, Family forming, Menopause and Men’s health support services.
Regular team-building events that foster collaboration and connection.
Best-in-class training and career development programs.
Exclusive discounts on restaurants, spas, clothing, gyms, entertainment, and more.
Access to a fitness tracking app with rewards for staying active.
Free parking space at the city center office location.

0-5%

jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

On any given day, every moment matters to someone, somewhere. And every moment, Motorola Solutions’ innovations, products and services play essential roles in people’s lives. We help firefighters see around buildings and police officers see around street corners. We keep utility workers connected and visible to each other with real-time voice and data communication across the smart grid. And we provide the situational awareness first responders need when a moment brings catastrophe. We help people be their best in their moments that matter.

Our Deployment team works on the Pronto Digital Policing app.

Pronto is the most popular mobile policing application in the UK, trusted by over half of the UK’s 45 police forces - and used by around 75,000 police officers on a daily basis. Pronto has been designed with and for front line operational users. As a result, it is an intuitive solution, with positive adoption, excellent user compliance and consistently positive feedback.

Based in the West End of Glasgow, we currently have around 100 employees. Our team started as Kelvin Connect in 2002, a spin-out company from the University of Glasgow. Now, as part of Motorola Solutions, we continue to expand with future opportunities in the UK and beyond.

You’ll work as part of an agile squad, taking part in sprint planning sessions, daily scrums and sprint reviews and retrospectives. You’ll have the opportunity to join us at social events like go-karting, clay pigeon shooting or come along for a drink with us after work on a Friday.

Job Description

The Technical Project Manager will work within a squad of other Technical Project Managers, software engineers and quality assurance engineers. As part of this squad they will oversee and share tasks for a number of projects with the other Technical Project Managers.

A Technical Project Manager is a subject-matter expert who uses their technical background to bridge the gap between the product and technical side of product development. They breathe life into a product by enacting the vision and direction defined in the product roadmap.

Responsibilities

Typical activities involved in the delivery of a Motorola Solutions software solution for which the Technical Project Manager is responsible include:

Producing a project plan and agreeing this with the customer
Managing the development and testing of the solution in alignment with the agreed project plan
Deployment and customer sign-off of the solution

This is a hybrid role, where time will be split between our Glasgow office and your home.

Key Responsibilities And Accountabilities

Accountable for the development and delivery of the project delivery plan to a strategic customer or number of customers
Accountable for the development of the business process benefits being achieved by a customer
Responsible for the management of the application development in accordance with the customer requirements.
Responsible for implementation of UAT/SAT in accordance with the test plan.
Responsible for management of the training and deployment plan.
Responsible for the management of the support plan.
Responsible for the in-life technical customer relationship plan.
Develop and maintain the project plan in accordance with customer requirements
Develop and maintain the documentation relating to the business process re-engineering
Manage the development of an application in accordance with the customers requirements
Coordinate the planning of the design and installation of the appropriate technical architecture for a solution
Manage the customer testing phases of a project deployment, including SAT and UAT
Manage the support of the solution once in-life
Manage the issues raised by a customer in relation to a deployed solution
Develop and maintain the documentation relating to business benefits realisation
Manage any third party supplier involvement in project delivery
Develop and maintain all project related documentation
Identify any new opportunities relating to potential sales opportunities

Basic Requirements

Person Profile / Core Competencies

A high level of communication skills - written and verbal
A high level of technical understanding - with the ability to communicate complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences
Diplomacy skills for establishing and managing relationships with customer stakeholders
Well organised and disciplined in approach to work and time management
Must be able to satisfy the requirements for Non-Police Personnel Vetting (NPPV) Level 3

Technical Expertise / Qualifications

A formal qualification (Degree) in Computing Science or equivalent experience
Knowledge of Agile Project management principles - with certification or working towards certification
Experience of managing the delivery of large and complex software solutions to major customers
Proven experience in managing customer requirements
Proven leadership and motivation of virtual teams
Demonstrable management experience in a delivery-driven environment
Technical experience sufficient to manage and convey issues relating to complex software issues
Demonstrable experience of project management in a technical environment with a successful track record in product delivery

In Return For Your Expertise, We’ll Support You In This New Challenge With Coaching & Development Every Step Of The Way. Also, To Reward Your Hard Work You’ll Get

jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Overview:

SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory is seeking an Infrastructure Project Manager to deliver world-class design and construction of facilities and infrastructure projects in support of world-changing scientific research. In this role, the project manager will generally be responsible for leading or supporting the planning, developing, procurement, design, construction, and close-out/transition to operations of infrastructure projects up to $10M.

This position will liaise with a broad range of client groups and stakeholders, including SLAC scientists and physicists, management and operations, finance and contracting, facilities engineers and technicians, and others. When supporting larger projects, this position may support a senior project manager or project director in managing engineering and design requirements, design and construction submittals, correspondence with project stakeholders and senior management, technical evaluations of bid proposals, development and review of construction cost estimates and project schedules, and similar tasks.

This position is an employee of Stanford University, providing support to the Department of Energy (DOE) contract at SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory. This position requires a personal and professional commitment to delivering safe, quality design and construction performance to support the science mission. This position reports to the Project Management Group within the Design and Construction Services Department of the Project Portfolio Management Office Division.

Your Specific Responsibilities Include

Project management of small minor construction projects, generally Project Manager responsible to deliver electrical, mechanical, and civil infrastructure design and construction work scopes of the assigned project(s).
Development and management of critical paths and schedules. Detailed knowledge of project schedules, including awareness on interdependencies with other project’s schedules and laboratory’s operational downtimes.
Cost control the assigned major project control account and/or cost account of the assigned projects.
Perform the full range of project management cycle on assigned project control accounts, including initiating, planning, executing, monitoring, and controlling, and closing of all responsible WBS activities. Independently lead and direct work scopes and deliverables that involve functional integrations with multiple engineering systems and disciplines.
Develop and maintain project documentation including project execution plan, communication plan and acquisition strategy plan. Responsible for development of resource plan for assigned project control accounts, including level of effort for management, supporting labor, materials, and time required to complete the assigned project control accounts including planning, design, and construction of infrastructure.
Facilitate discussions and negotiations between SLAC stakeholders to drive consensus on project design and operation requirements along with the Design Manager.
Through the subcontract technical representative, direct the work of subcontractors to successfully complete the assigned project control accounts. Ensure that project requirements are captured, and the design meets the program requirements as established by the project stakeholders and approved project documentation.
Utilize approved project management system, processes and tools during design and construction to ensure alignment with PPMO and DOE’s reporting requirements for Project Status and Quality Assurance.
Organize and hold design readiness and technical reviews along with the Design Manager.
Identify and manage project risks and actively monitor mitigation measures to control cost, schedule, and scope.
Utilize comprehensive change management strategies.
Ensure that construction conforms to SLAC policies and engineering specifications under dynamic working conditions.
Given the nature of this position, SLAC is open to on-site and hybrid work options

Responsibilities

Core Duties
:

Perform the full range of project management cycle: initiating, planning, executing, monitoring and controlling, and closing. Lead projects requiring functional integration. Complete sub-project and/or stand-alone elements (or a contained project such as construction project).
Direct development of an action plan, and estimate requirements for resources, including management, labor, materials, and time required to complete project.
Facilitate discussions and negotiations to drive recommendation consensus within scope of responsibility.
Develop and help execute comprehensive change management strategy and communication plan relative to project scope and stakeholders on a focused project; actively manage resistance to change.
These elements typically delineate the project management involved at this level: Charter- charter and scoping involvement or scope definition, identify and shape scope; # of disciplines /stakeholders to manage is contained to localized department or university constituents; risk- manage and report on risks associated with projects to upper management, risk sharing is maintained between management and project manager; project complexity involves straight-forward technology applications to drive decisions; primary university relationship is at the individual faculty, department /director level; single project budget/scope accountability up to $5M; cumulative budget/scope up to $10M.

Minimum Education

Bachelor's degree in a related field

Minimum Experience

Three years of related experience in management of projects of moderate size/complexity with limited performance risk, including project planning, scheduling, tracking, and budgeting, or combination of education and relevant experience.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Polished written and oral communication skills to address a wide variety of audiences.
Ability to productively engage and influence cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated project management ability to employ integration, scope time management, cost, quality, human resources, communications, risk, and procurement components.
Demonstrated resilience, diplomacy, influence, relationship building, and problem solving skills in a variety of situations.
Depth of knowledge in technical discipline/domain needed to deliver projects.

jobs.title: Project Manager 2 - Facilities/Construction
jobs.description:
Position Overview

JOB DESCRIPTION

This position is an employee of Stanford University, providing support to the Department of Energy (DOE) contract at SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory. The Design and Construction Services (DCS) group is seeking a Senior Project Manager to deliver world-class design and construction of facilities and infrastructure projects in support of world-changing scientific research and will be assigned as the CUIR Project Manager. This project manager will be responsible for planning, developing, procurement, design, construction, and close-out/transition to operations of project scope(s) ranging from $1M to $250M. SLAC currently has multiple ongoing projects to improve scientific research capabilities and to maintain existing infrastructure, including backbone utility systems and experimental spaces such as research laboratories, cleanrooms, and associated MEP systems.

The Senior Project Manager also could be assigned to one major project (>$34M) or several minor projects. Major projects at SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory include Department of Energy line-item projects such as the Critical Utilities Infrastructure Revitalization (CUIR) and the Linac Coherent Light Source-II-High Energy (LCLS-II-HE). Minor projects include a wide range of infrastructure improvements such as electrical distribution system repairs and upgrades, cooling tower replacements, roadways repairs and pipeline/culverts repair and replacements.

When serving on a major project, the Senior Project Manager is accountable to the Project Director or Infrastructure System Manager of the major project. When serving on minor projects, the Senior Project Manager is accountable to the Project Management Manager. The Senior Project Manager carries responsibility and authority for planning, coordinating and executing critical project scopes to ensure the project’s mission and program are met in terms of technical scope, cost, schedule and resources.

The successful candidate will liaise with a broad range of SLAC organization groups and stakeholders, including SLAC scientists and physicists, operations and engineering, finance and contracting, facilities maintenance experts and project managers of other systems. In addition, the senior project manager is responsible for coordinating the engineering and design process, managing A/E service design contracts and construction contracts during construction. The senior project manager is also responsible for presenting project information to DOE in Project Reviews, SLAC Project Assurance and Advisory Group [TN1] and regular monthly meetings attended by senior leaders.

Your Specific Responsibilities Include

The primary focus on this position will be on delivering electrical, mechanical and civil infrastructure design and construction work scopes of the assigned major or minor project(s).
Perform the full range of project management cycle on assigned project control accounts, including initiating, planning, executing, monitoring and controlling, and closing of all responsible WBS activities. Independently lead and direct work scopes and deliverables that involve functional integrations with multiple engineering systems and disciplines.
Development and management of critical paths and schedules. This position requires detailed knowledge of project schedule, with a high level of awareness on interdependencies with other major projects' schedule and laboratory’s operation downtimes. Develop and maintain a project baseline.
Managing projects to ensure the project meets its deliverables within cost, schedule, and technical expectations.
Direct development of project execution plan, communication plan and acquisition strategy plans. Responsible for development of resources plan for assigned project control accounts, including level of effort for management, supporting labor, materials, and time required to complete the assigned project control accounts.
Facilitate discussions and negotiations between SLAC stakeholders to drive consensus on project design and operation requirements.
Perform technical oversight of the project. Oversee the work of subcontractors and Architects/Engineers consultants to successfully complete the assigned project control accounts. Ensure that project requirements are captured and the design meets the program requirements as established by the project stakeholders and approved project documentation. Develop and maintain project documentation.
Organize and prioritize the work of the project team.
Utilize approved project management system, processes and tools during design and construction to ensure alignment with SLAC Project Portfolio Management Office’s and DOE’s reporting requirements from an overall Project Status and Quality Assurance perspective. Ensure the use of standard DOE O 413.3B project management tools.
Organize and hold design readiness and technical reviews. Identify and manage responsible project accounts’ risks and actively monitor mitigation measures to control cost, schedule, and scope. Identify and manage project risks and make critical decisions.
Integrate Environmental Safety & Health (ES&H) considerations in planning, design and construction of facilities. Ensure implementation of SLAC ES&H policy and best practices in construction. Ultimately responsible for general contractor activities such as safety, configuration, cost and schedule control on assigned project control accounts. Execute the project in compliance with the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) and other applicable ES&H rules and regulations.
Establish staffing needs and manage project resource requests.
Foster a culture of safety and respect.
Ensure that construction conforms to SLAC policies and engineering specifications under very dynamic working conditions.
Interacts with DOE SLAC Site Office representatives along with the Project Director or Infrastructure System Manager to convey status of the project and proactively communicate challenges as they arise.
Other duties may also be assigned.
Given the nature of this position, SLAC is open to on-site and hybrid work options

jobs.title: Senior Research and Development Program Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

Silvus Technologies is dedicated to one mission: connecting those who keep us safe. We do so by delivering the most advanced Mobile Ad-hoc Network (MANET) radios powered by our custom and ever evolving Mobile-Networked MIMO waveform. Together, our radios and waveform provide vital communications for mission critical applications in the harshest environments from underground tunnels to high altitude balloons.

Silvus StreamCaster™ radios are being rapidly adopted by customers all over the world ranging from the U.S. and Allied Nations Departments of Defense, to International, Federal, State and Local Law Enforcement agencies, all the way to the Superbowl, Grammys and industry-leading drone, robot, and unmanned systems manufacturers.

Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “Keeping Our Heroes Connected”?

Silvus’ rapid growth is fueled by a focus on research and innovation and a team of the most passionate, skilled and creative thinking individuals. If you are looking for a challenging experience, you owe it to yourself to learn how Silvus can be the next chapter of your career.

Job Description

THE OPPORTUNITY

Silvus Technologies, the global leader in advanced MIMO mesh networking solutions for defense, industrial, and public safety applications, is seeking a Senior Research and Development (R&D) Program Manager
who will report to the Vice President of Research and Development (R&D).

This is a foundational role for Silvus R&D that blends technical know-how with strategic thinking and process-oriented execution. This position offers a unique opportunity to shape and deliver key new technology solutions within Silvus’ growing R&D organization. The Program Manager will partner closely with Senior R&D and Engineering leadership, as well as Silvus management, Business Development, and Product teams to define programmatic goals, both technical and strategic, drive cross-functional project execution, and deliver high-impact products to Silvus customers.

This role is part of a passionate team redefining radio frequency (RF) sensing, electronic warfare and wireless connectivity in the most demanding environments, from battlefield networks and autonomous systems to public safety and industrial applications. You will work alongside world-class engineers solving real-world challenges, with opportunities to grow, innovate, and lead as our organization scales.

This position is based at Silvus Technologies’ headquarters in the heart of vibrant West Los Angeles,
CA,
and is on a hybrid schedule, a minimum of 3 days onsite per week is expected. On-site days are Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays.

The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.

Role And Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end program execution across the full engineering lifecycle, from concept and design through implementation, integration, validation, and productization.
Own program definition, scope and objectives inside the Silvus R&D group as well as in engagements with Silvus groups outside R&D and organizations outside Silvus.
Own program schedules, milestones, and deliverables, ensuring alignment across cross-functional teams including Systems, FPGA, Software, RF, Hardware, and QA.
Facilitate cross-team collaboration to identify and resolve technical or schedule blockers, driving timely and data-driven decisions in collaboration with product, sales, and business development organizations.
Track risks, dependencies, and issues; develop mitigation strategies and communicate impacts and resource demands to R&D leadership and upper management.
Drive engineering cadence and communication, including design reviews, design syncs, and status updates with internal and external stakeholders.
Maintain project documentation and dashboards (e.g., Confluence, JIRA) for clear visibility into goals, progress, and key metrics.
Prepare executive reports and presentations, communicating program status, milestones, and risk assessments to senior management.
Hire, manage, and mentor various engineers, junior program managers, and other key personnel as needed to support the growth and success of the Silvus R&D organization.
Perform other related duties, of which the above are representative.

Required Qualifications

Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field plus a minimum of 10 years of relevant program management and/or engineering experience in a technology-driven organization.
Proven experience managing complex hardware/software wireless communications, networking, or electronic warfare programs in a fast-paced R&D or product development environment.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple programs and shift priorities.
Exceptional communication and presentation abilities with a track record of influencing across technical and non-technical teams.
Must be a U.S. Citizen (due to clients under U.S. government contracts).
All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check and drug test.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Ph.D. in EE, ECE, or a related field with 15+ years of relevant industry experience.
Demonstrated success with hands-on product development, technical program management, or engineering leadership roles.
Technical fluency in multiple areas such as: wireless systems design, RF engineering, networking, electronic warfare, firmware/software integration, and test/validation.
Self-starter with a strong sense of ownership, capable of driving progress with minimal oversight.
Eligibility for U.S. Security Clearance.

Working Conditions And Physical Requirements

Office environment.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to do the following:
Lift equipment up to 20 lbs. for the set-up of demonstrations and testing.
Walking/Moving in the labs.

COMPENSATION: $185,000 - $245,000 / annually

jobs.title: Professional Development Program Manager
jobs.description:
Summary/Objective

The Professional Development Program Manager supports the development, implementation and continuous improvement of APS professional development programs. The Manager is responsible for day-to-day project management of in-person, virtual and on-demand programs, coordinating faculty, subject matter experts, volunteers and staff; supporting course and curriculum development; administering learning technologies; tracking program performance; and ensuring programs are delivered on time, within budget and to a consistent standard. The position serves as a key point of contact for learners, volunteers and other stakeholders involved in professional development activities.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
1. Manage Professional Development Programs and Projects

· Manage professional development programs from planning through implementation, evaluation and follow-up, using clear project plans, timelines and deliverables.
· Manage grant-funded programs, ensuring program activities, documentation and reporting meet grant requirements and deadlines.
· Maintain accurate program records, calendars and budgets and analyze data for program reports.
· Maintain quality control of course assets, video content, interactive elements, and user experience to ensure alignment with instructional design best practices.
· Collaborate with the Professional Development Director on generating and implementing new program format ideas.
· Collaborate across APS teams on program positioning, promotion and implementation.
2. Administer Learning Platforms and Learner Experience

· Administer programs within APS’s learning management system (LMS), including course setup, enrollment, content updates, learner communications, completion tracking and troubleshooting.
· Serve as a responsive point of contact for learners, subject matter experts and volunteers, resolving routine questions and escalating issues as appropriate.
· Host and support virtual learning programs, including speaker preparation, technical coordination, participant materials and follow-up.
3. Manage Volunteer and Stakeholder Engagement

· Build productive working relationships with APS volunteers, subject matter experts, partners and staff involved in professional development programs and activities.
· Serve as staff liaison for APS professional development-related committees, including meeting preparation, materials, scheduling, follow-up and action tracking.

Skills/Abilities

1. Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage timelines, deliverables, budgets and competing priorities with attention to detail.
2. Ability to coordinate educational programs, courses, webinars and learning experiences for diverse audiences.
3. Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with learners, volunteers, subject matter experts and staff.
4. Proficiency with learning management systems, virtual meeting platforms and standard office technology; ability to learn and administer new systems as needed.
5. Ability to analyze program data, track participation and outcomes, and support reporting and continuous improvement efforts.
6. Sound judgment, initiative and problem-solving skills, including the ability to resolve routine issues and escalate matters appropriately.
7. Ability to build collaborative working relationships across departments and with external stakeholders, including volunteers, faculty, partners and vendors.
8. Commitment to responsive customer service, professionalism and consistent delivery of high-quality professional development programs.

Education and Experience

1. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
2. Four to six years of progressively responsible experience in professional development and/or education. Ideally, experience working with associations or not-for-profit entities, and with place-based and online programs.
3. Experience managing educational programs, courses or webinars and working with speakers, volunteers or subject matter experts.
4. Knowledge and experience applying adult learning and instructional design principles to programming, including stacking programs into learning pathways, certificates or other curricula preferred.
5. Experience with learning management systems, virtual meeting platforms or other learning technologies preferred.
6. Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects and deadlines from planning through implementation.
7. Strong organizational, project management, problem-solving and attention-to-detail skills.
8. Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills and a demonstrated commitment to responsive customer service.
9. Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively across teams.
10. Experience working in a scientific, professional society or nonprofit environment preferred.
11. Ability to travel for APS meetings and programs as needed.

Other Duties

1. Support the development, review and maintenance of professional development materials, resources, templates and standard operating procedures.
2. Assist with program-related communications, evaluation summaries, reports and presentations for internal and external audiences.
3. Participate in cross-functional APS initiatives, meetings or special projects that support the Community Division and organizational priorities.
4. Represent APS professionally when interacting with members, learners, volunteers, partners and other stakeholders.
Other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibility

This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.

Benefits

This is a full-time, exempt position offering a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including a 403(b) retirement plan; paid holidays; generous annual and sick leave; medical, dental, and vision coverage; flexible spending accounts; and life and short- and long-term disability insurance.

Where will you work?

We offer a flexible hybrid work model, with employees based out of our headquarters in Rockville, Maryland (Washington, DC metro area). Employees are required to work in the Rockville office every Wednesday as part of our standard hybrid schedule. Additional in-office days may be required based on role, team needs, division meetings, staff meetings, or other organizational events.

Because regular in-person attendance is an essential part of our hybrid work model, applicants should be located within a reasonable commuting distance of Rockville, Maryland. At this time, we are only considering candidates located in the Washington, DC metro area.

All qualified applicants must submit a resume, cover letter, and salary expectations through the APS Careers Page.

To learn more about APS Publications, please visit https://journals.physiology.org.

jobs.description:
Requisition Summary

The Environmental Program Manager leads and coordinates PACCAR Technical Center's environmental programs, management systems, compliance initiatives, sustainability objectives, and improvement portfolio. The role is the central point of coordination among Operations, Facilities, Engineering, Safety, Security, Corporate Environmental Affairs, regulatory agencies, consultants, contractors, and service providers.

This position provides program governance and strategic direction to ensure environmental commitments are planned, executed, monitored, and reported in alignment with federal, state, local, corporate, and ISO 14001 requirements. The Environmental Program Manager combines environmental subject-matter leadership with cross-functional program execution, audit readiness, risk management, performance tracking, and continuous improvement.

Company Information

PACCAR is a Fortune 500 company established in 1905 and recognized as a global leader in the commercial vehicle industry, with internationally recognized brands including Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF. PACCAR is a global technology leader in the design, manufacture, and support of high-quality commercial vehicles, diesel engines, financial services, and information technology solutions.

The PACCAR Technical Center provides engineering excellence to PACCAR's truck and engine divisions through innovative product development and testing. Located in the Skagit Valley approximately 65 miles north of Seattle, the Technical Center supports PACCAR's global operations through advanced engineering and testing services.

Job Functions / Responsibilities

Serve as the site leader for environmental programs, regulatory relationships, compliance risks, and strategic initiatives
Develop program roadmaps, operating plans, priorities, milestones, metrics, and leadership reporting
Lead cross-functional teams, align resources with business objectives, and prepare for emerging regulatory and operational requirements
Administer and continuously improve the site ISO 14001 Environmental Management System (EMS), including policies, procedures, objectives, and documentation.
Lead management reviews, internal and external audits, certification activities, performance reporting, and corrective actions.
Manage environmental compliance, permits, inspections, audits, agency correspondence, corrective actions, and required reporting.
Interpret requirements, maintain compliance calendars, and communicate obligations to leadership and operational teams.
Represent the Technical Center during agency inspections, regulatory discussions, and corporate environmental reviews.
Oversee hazardous and universal waste, wastewater, stormwater, SPCC, air quality and Title V, SARA/EPCRA, greenhouse gas reporting, hazardous materials, chemical management, Safety Data Sheets, and zero waste programs.
Direct hazardous, industrial, and special waste characterization, storage, transportation, manifesting, and disposal.
Integrate environmental compliance and sustainability requirements into operational planning and capital projects.
Lead projects and initiatives that reduce environmental risk, emissions, waste, resource use, and operating costs while improving program maturity and audit outcomes.
Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and project management principles to implement environmental best practices and support PACCAR stewardship goals.
Manage consultants, auditors, contractors, waste service providers, scopes of work, schedules, deliverables, performance, contracts, and budgets.
Build partnerships across site, corporate, regulatory, and external stakeholders to strengthen environmental awareness, accountability, and engagement.
Develop and deliver environmental compliance training for employees, contractors, and new hires.
Prepare reports, dashboards, presentations, executive updates, and employee communications.
Provide technical guidance and mentoring to environmental staff and cross-functional teams, influencing results without direct authority.

Qualifications

Experience with ISO 14001 or other management system frameworks, including audits and certification activities.
7+ years of experience leading environmental programs, projects, operations, compliance initiatives, or management systems.
Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams and complex initiatives.
Strong organizational, regulatory interpretation, problem-solving, written, verbal, and presentation skills.
Ability to build relationships with regulators, corporate leadership, operational teams, consultants, and service providers.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and environmental data management systems.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Environmental Management, Environmental Science, Business, Engineering, Program Management, Sustainability, Public Administration, or related fields.

As a U.S. PACCAR employee, you have a full range of benefit options including:

401k with up to a 5% company match
Fully funded pension plan that provides monthly benefits after retirement
Comprehensive paid time off – minimum of 10 paid vacation days (additional days are provided with additional seniority/years of service), 12 paid holidays, and sick time
Tuition reimbursement for continued education
Medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family
Flexible spending accounts (FSA) and health savings account (HSA)
Paid short-and long-term disability programs
Life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance
EAP services including wellness plans, estate planning, financial counseling and more

Additional Job Board Information

PACCAR is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veteran/Disability and E-Verify Employer. At PACCAR, we value talent and promote growth and development. We carefully consider numerous compensation factors including your education, training, or experience. The salary range for the Environmental Program Manager is $104,100 - $162,900 annually. Additionally, this role is eligible for the full range of benefit options listed above.

This role offers the opportunity to help shape a rapidly growing Distribution organization while supporting some of the nation's largest electric utility clients.

These roles are ideal for individuals who take ownership, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy building long-term client partnerships. Project Managers work closely with engineering and business leaders to deliver successful outcomes for clients while supporting the continued growth of the Distribution business.

The Team

The Distribution Project Management Team
is a client-facing organization responsible for delivering distribution engineering services, utility programs, and EPC projects for investor-owned utilities and other clients across the country. Our team partners closely with engineering, operations, and business leaders to achieve successful project outcomes and build lasting client relationships. We value collaboration, accountability, client partnership, and a shared commitment to high-quality delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Manages Distribution Engineering Services projects, utility programs, and EPC-related work, with responsibility for scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk management, and client satisfaction. Leads multidisciplinary teams and serves as the primary point of accountability for client communication, expectation management, issue resolution, and coordination among clients, engineering teams, and key stakeholders. Supports staffing, planning, execution, financial performance, and long-term client relationship development across a growing portfolio of utility work.

Key Responsibilities

Own delivery of assigned distribution projects, portfolios, or programs with accountability for scope, schedule, cost, quality, and client satisfaction
Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for assigned clients, coordinating project priorities, decisions, deliverables, and expectations while developing trusted, long-term relationships
Establish clear communication protocols and lead regular client meetings and reporting on scope, schedule, budget, quality, risks, decisions, and action items
Facilitate alignment with clients on project scope, assumptions, priorities, acceptance criteria, and change management throughout the project lifecycle
Proactively communicate emerging issues and potential impacts, coordinate timely decisions, and drive resolution before concerns affect project delivery

Job Description

The North Carolina Department of Revenue ("NCDOR") is undertaking a multi-year, comprehensive Tax System Modernization Program. This strategic initiative will modernize and integrate NCDOR's core tax administration systems and applications, operational workflows, taxpayer service channels, and data structures across five major software release cycles. NCDOR awarded a contract in October 2026 for a Vendor to provide and implement a new integrated tax system. While there is a significant technology shift, this modernization effort is transformational for the agency requiring focus and incorporation of best practices for Enterprise Program and Project Management, Organizational Change Management ("OCM"), Systems and User Acceptance Testing, and End User System Training to ensure successful program execution, quality assurance, organizational readiness, and stakeholder alignment.

Tax System Modernization Program Manager

The Program Manager is part of the Transformation Management Office (TMO). The position reports directly to the Program Sponsor (Chief Deputy Secretary) along with the Technical Program Director and Functional Program Director. The individual leads the planning and monitoring of the program. This role works with various stakeholders on strategic program planning, stakeholder engagement, cross-functional coordination, and program scheduling and resource analysis. The ideal candidate is well-versed in large transformation programs, has exceptional project management skills, and has experience working within the public sector.

Collaborate with the tax system vendor and TMO to develop and oversee a comprehensive tax system modernization roadmap including multiple releases with a detailed schedule, resource allocations, and milestones.
Coordinate with the tax system vendor, Technical Program Director and Functional Program Director from planning and analysis to execution and deployment.
Ensure program management best practices are being followed throughout the program, including effective documentation, communication, and change management.
Identify key program risks and ensure risk mitigation strategies and plans are documented to support program success.
Identify and manage decisions, issues and action items to ensure timely resolution to avoid program delays.
Serve as the primary contact for the tax system vendor Project Manager.
Ensure alignment with other NCDOR IT portfolio initiatives identifying and addressing dependencies, resource constraints and conflicts, and risks.
Create and deliver regular status reports, dashboards and Executive Steering Committee presentations and updates.
Submit required information and comply with the Department of Information Technology reporting requirements.
Develop methods to measure and report on program benefits.
Facilitate Executive Steering Committee and Program Management Governance Meetings.
Ensure contractor onboarding and off-boarding happens timely and aligns with resource planning and program schedule.
Oversee technology and service vendor deliverables according to contract and payment milestones.
Collaborate closely with agency IT leads, business analysts, and third-party contractors to ensure effective teamwork.
Manage Change Requests working with the appropriate steering committee or board to present proposed changes and acquire decisions for approval or rejection.

Stakeholder Engagement

Coordinate with other state agencies or third parties to discuss changes needed by other IT departments to support the program (e.g. interface changes).
Collaborate with the Functional Program Director to plan activities associated with the organizational change management strategy and plan.
Participate in planning and attend meetings and discussions with external customers impacted by the new tax system.

Team Management

Lead a cross-functional team of project managers responsible for managing specific aspects of the program (i.e. data conversion, interfaces). Project management staff may fluctuate throughout the life of the program.
Provide guidance, mentorship, and performance oversight to team members.

Budget & Resource Management

Collaborate with Procurement and the TMO Program Directors on timelines for procuring goods and services to support the program timelines.
Maintain and oversee the staffing plan, ensuring sufficient allocation of NCDOR resources to meet program timelines.
Track completion of contract milestones and payment approval; participate in forecasting future budget needs for the program.

Compliance & Risk Management

Collaborate with the Technical Program Director and internal technical team members responsible for adherence to all state, federal, and agency regulations to identify work tasks for inclusion in the program schedule, including dependencies.

Qualifications & Experience

Minimum of 7 years of experience in program or project management. PMP or PgMP certification preferred.
Proven experience managing large-scale modernization or transformation projects, ideally within government or public sector.
Experience with public-sector taxation operations or technologies is a plus.
Experience with Agile project management methodologies is a plus.
Proven experience developing high-quality status reports and dashboards.
Proven experience presenting to executive-level stakeholders.
General knowledge of state and federal regulatory standards for government technology.

Skills

Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact with and engage a wide range of stakeholders.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in project management software (e.g., MS Project).
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, SharePoint and MS Teams; advanced skills preferred.

You've been around the block (in a good way), and you have the experience to back it up. This role combines people leadership with program execution to support parts sales by improving product cross-references, attributes, digital assets, data mapping, and systems integration.

The manager will lead cross-functional initiatives, establish and enforce data standards, resolve data quality issues, and deliver measurable business results. Using tools such as Python, Snowflake, Tableau, and generative AI, this role will monitor product data health and provide actionable insights into industry trends, competitive activity, and market positioning.

Job Functions / Responsibilities

Leads Product Information Management (PIM) system ownership, including product data lifecycle management, system enhancements, and data quality.
Develops and maintains the Product Data Standards Guide, defining requirements for launching parts on e-commerce sites, formatting product data, and ensuring data completeness.
Embeds SEO best practices into data governance rules by establishing and enforcing naming conventions and keyword requirements that maximize search discoverability.
Collaborates with Product Marketing teams and suppliers to improve product data quality.
Creates, monitors, and enforces data quality audits to proactively identify inconsistencies and ensure compliance with established standards.
Monitors data health dashboards to assess completeness and accuracy, prioritizing remediation efforts and enhancements based on findings.
Serves as the final quality gatekeeper for product data, providing analysts with specific feedback to correct errors at the source before publication.
Develops and leverages generative AI to create data visualizations, executive summaries, dashboards, and infographics that provide sales and marketing leaders with actionable market insights.
Monitors industry news and collaborates with global partners to maintain accurate PACCAR competitive analyses.
Leads process improvement initiatives across product data management and market intelligence.
Leads, coaches, and develops a team of product and market data professionals by establishing priorities, assigning resources, managing performance, and fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications & Skills

7 Years of relevant work experience required.
Previous supervision or management expereince required.

jobs.title: Competitive Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Location: New York or Remote (U.S.)

The Opportunity

Varonis is one of the most respected names in AI and data security, trusted by more than 8,000 customers to protect their most valuable data against cyberattacks.

We're looking for a highly technical, deeply curious Competitive Intelligence Analyst to lead our CI program. Your job is simple to state and hard to do: help Varonis win. You'll research competitors, pressure-test their claims, devise winning plays, and build the tools and automation that let our field self-serve competitive insight at scale. You'll be the person sellers pull into their hardest deals, and the person whose materials they actually reach for.

You'll use AI agents to automate much of the CI function, both to accelerate your own research and analysis and to let sales teams self-serve answers in real time.

What You'll Own

Deal Support

Provide tailored, proactive support on competitive deals, addressing competitor-specific challenges before they stall an opportunity.
Develop a deep rapport with the field so you're the first call when a competitor shows up in a deal.

Content Creation

Build the tools that win deals: battlecards, playbooks, kill sheets, customer-facing comparisons, and technical positioning, all written to be used, not filed away.
Produce sharp materials. Clear points, backed by specific, real examples, not a wall of content or vague positioning.

Competitive Analysis

Run quarterly win/loss analysis with product marketing to understand why we win, why we lose, and how to improve competitive conversion rates.
Connect the dots across functions, feeding deal insight to sales, roadmap input and product gaps to product, and positioning and messaging to marketing.

Competitive News & Questions

Maintain an ongoing pulse on the market, monitoring competitor product updates, announcements, and strategy shifts.
Share timely, sourced analysis with the stakeholders who need it, and build compelling narratives, including win-wires, that the field remembers and repeats.

AI-First Operating Model & CompetiBot Upkeep

Own and continuously improve CompetiBot, our competitive intelligence agent, and the automation behind it, so the field can self-serve accurate, sourced competitive answers at scale.
Design, prompt, and tune agent-based workflows that monitor the market, synthesize intelligence, and surface field-ready guidance, freeing you for higher-order analysis.

Who You Are

You're technical to the core. We win in the weeds, so you understand competitor architectures, deployment realities, and product gaps well enough to hold your own with any SE or CSA.

You speak the language of the field, not marketing speak. You understand the sales and pre-sales motion and how deals are actually won and lost, which is why the field pulls you into their calls.

You're genuinely excited about AI, not intimidated by it. You see agents as leverage, and you enjoy designing and tuning workflows that scale your impact across the whole field.

You're a skeptic by instinct. You carry a healthy skepticism toward marketing claims and unsupported narratives. You validate before you repeat.

You're a builder with a bias for action. You have an ownership mentality and a track record of taking projects from idea to execution to results.

What We're Looking For

5+ years in the cybersecurity market, with a strong focus on data, identity, and cloud security.
3+ years of relevant experience in one or more of: sales engineering/pre-sales, field-facing competitive intelligence, solutions or technical marketing, product marketing, or product management.
A strong technical foundation and the ability to break down complex systems into actionable insight.
Hands-on comfort with AI agents and automation, or genuine eagerness to learn fast. We want someone curious enough to run their own experiments and wire workflows together, not someone waiting for a tool to be handed to them.
Proven ability to simplify complex technical ideas into practical, succinct guidance and executive summaries.
Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with impeccable attention to detail and experience presenting to executives.
Insatiable curiosity about the cybersecurity market. You already track its every move.

Why Varonis

One of the most technically respected companies in data security. Our platform protects what matters most.
A role where your job is to help the company win, with visibility across sales, product, and marketing.
A company investing seriously in AI across the go-to-market function, where you'll build the agent-driven future of CI.
Competitive compensation, equity, and a culture that values ownership and impact.

This position is remote with occasional travel to Varonis HQ in New York City and to corporate tradeshows. Regular remote collaboration with colleagues in Israel is required.

We invite you to check out our Instagram Page to gain further insight into the Varonis culture!

@VaronisLife

Analytic Experience: Candidate will be a part of the technical team responsible for providing analytic consulting services, supporting analytic workflow and product development and testing, promoting the user adoption of methods and best practices from data science, conducting applied methods projects, and supporting the creation of analysis-ready data.
Onsite Support: Candidate will be the face of the CHEETAS Team and will be responsible for ensuring stakeholders have the analytical tools, data products and reports they need to make insightful recommendations based on your data driven analysis.
Stakeholder Assistance: Candidate will directly assisting both analyst / technical and non-analyst / non-technical stakeholders with the analysis of DoD datasets and demonstrating the 'art of the possible' to the stakeholders and VIPs with insights gained from your analysis of DoD Test and Evaluation (T&E) data.
Communication: Must effectively communicate at both a programmatic and technical level. Although you potentially may be the only team member physically on-site supporting you will not be alone. You will have support from other data science team members as well as the software engineering and system administration teams.
Technical Support: Candidate will be responsible for running and operating CHEETAS (and other tools); demonstrating these tools to stakeholders & VIPs; conveying analysis results; adapting internally-developed tools, notebooks and reports to meet emerging needs; gathering use cases, requirements, gaps and needs from stakeholders and for larger development items providing that information as feature requests or bug reports to the CHEETAS development team; and performing impromptu hands-on training sessions with end users and potentially troubleshooting problems from within closed networks without internet access (with support from distributed team members).
Independent Work: Candidate must be self-motivated and capable of working independently with little supervision / direct tasking.

Work Environment:

Location: Onsite; Camarillo, California
Travel Requirements: This position will require travel of 25% with potential surge to 50% to support end users located at various DoD ranges & labs located across the US (including Alaska and Hawaii). When not supporting a site, this position can work remotely or from a nearby KBR office (if available and desired).
Working Hours: Standard, although you potentially may be the only team member physically on-site providing support, you will not be alone.

Education: A degree in operations research, engineering, applied math, statistics, computer science or information technology with preferred 15+ years of experience within DoD. Candidates with 10-15 years of DoD experience will be considered on a case-by-case basis. Entry level candidates will not be considered.
Technical Experience: Previous experience must include five (5) years of hands-on experience in big data analytics, five (5) years of hands-on experience with object-oriented and functional languages (e.g., Python, R, C++, C#, Java, Scala, etc.).
Data Experience: Experience in dealing with imperfections in data. Experience should demonstrate competency in key concepts from software engineering, computer programming, statistical analysis, data mining algorithms, machine learning, and modeling sufficient to inform technical choices and infrastructure configuration.
Data Analytics: Proven analytical skills and experience in preparing and handling large volumes of data for ETL processes. Experience should include working with teams in the development and interpretation the results of analytic products with DoD specific data types.
Big Data Infrastructure: Experience in the installation, configuration, and use of big data infrastructure (Spark, Trino, Hadoop, Hive, Neo4J, JanusGraph, HBase, MS SQL Server with Polybase, VMWare as examples). Experience in implementing Data Visualization solutions.

Qualifications Required:

Experience using notebooks (Jupyter Notebooks and RMarkdown) to create reproducible and explainable products.

Experience querying databases using SQL and working with and configuring distributed storage and computing environments to conduct analysis (Spark, Trino, Hadoop, Hive, Neo4J, JanusGraph, MongoDB, Accumulo, HBase as examples).
Experience working with code repositories in a collaborative team.

Ability to speak and present findings in front of large technical and non-technical groups.
Ability to create documentation and repeatable procedures to enable reproducible research.
Ability to create training and educational content for novice end users on the use of tools and novel analytic methods.
