The UDSD JV Trust & Safety Operations team is responsible for executing and overseeing day-to-day Human moderation activities. Our mission is to transform moderation from a labor-intensive process into a data-driven, system-powered operation that balances efficiency and accuracy, enabling TikTok to become the most trusted platform.

About the Role
The Business Operations Analyst role serves as the reporting governance and decision-support function within OEA. This role is responsible for creating trusted performance visibility, standardizing reporting logic, and generating actionable insights that support leadership decision-making across LoBs.

Key Responsibilities
- Establish and govern reporting standards, metric definitions, and visibility frameworks across LoBs to maintain a consistent source of truth.
- Build, maintain, and continuously improve recurring reporting, dashboards, scorecards, and executive-level performance views.
- Deliver high-impact deep-dives and structured analysis to identify trends, risks, performance drivers, and opportunities for improvement.
- Partner closely with Planning and Performance, LoB leaders, Data Science, Product, Engineering, and QA to align on definitions and data interpretation.
- Improve reporting efficiency by standardizing outputs, reducing manual effort, and identifying opportunities for automation in reporting workflows.
- Contribute to Operational Excellence and Automation by improving reporting scalability, reducing friction, and embedding insight-driven decision-making.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Experience in reporting, business intelligence, analytics, operations reporting, or related data-driven operational functions.
- Reporting Governance: Strong experience in building reporting standards, metric definitions, dashboard logic, and executive visibility mechanisms across multiple business areas.
- Strategic Insight: Proven ability to turn data into clear business narratives, identify systemic risks, and provide decision-useful recommendations rather than just reporting outputs.
- Cross-Functional Partnership: Experience working with Data Science, Product, Engineering, and Operations stakeholders to align definitions, resolve ambiguity, and improve consistency.
- Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present insights clearly to senior stakeholders.

Trust & Safety

Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis. ​
​
TikTok recognises that keeping our platform safe for the TikTok communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining. ​
​
We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person-centred, innovative and integrated approach.​

About USDS

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

jobs.description:
Job Description

About the Role

As a Data Analyst at NOV Downhole Broadband Solutions, you will serve as the primary technical and analytical support for our real-time and memory-based drilling services. Acting as a key focal point across up to three rigs at a time, you will monitor operations, interpret complex downhole datasets, and provide timely recommendations that enhance drilling performance, manage risk, and protect wellbore integrity.

You will support Project Managers as an in-house drilling advisor, own critical analytical workflows (from optimization reporting to post-well reviews), and act as a technical escalation point for both internal teams and clients. This role combines deep drilling domain knowledge with strong analytical skills and offers the opportunity to contribute directly to new software solutions, advanced tools, and industry-leading technical publications.

About The Company

NOV Downhole Broadband Solutions is a business group within the NOV Energy Products and Services segment, specializing in drilling automation and optimization through the use of real-time downhole data. By deploying Wired Drill Pipe (WDP) technology and Along-String Measurement (ASM) tools, we enable the transmission of high-density, low-latency data from downhole systems to surface teams. This includes key metrics such as temperature, pressure, rotation, and vibration data, which contribute to smarter, safer, and more efficient drilling operations. As demand grows, we continue to expand our operations and analytics teams to drive innovation and excellence for our customers.

What We Offer

Joining National Oilwell Varco means becoming part of a dynamic, international team committed to delivering outstanding results. We provide:

Challenging Assignments: Work on complex, high-impact drilling and well construction projects where advanced analytics directly influence operational decisions.
Career Development: Access strong technical career paths, mentoring, and opportunities to grow as a Data Analyst across drilling dynamics, data analytics, and digital solutions.
Collaborative Atmosphere: Thrive in an open and informal work environment where teamwork, innovation, and personal responsibility are valued.
Global Exposure: Collaborate with world-class clients, internal experts, and third-party partners on regional and global projects.

At NOV, your contributions make a difference. We look forward to welcoming motivated individuals ready to take their careers to the next level.

Why Join Our Global Family

We are a purpose-driven company on a mission to empower the global energy industry. At NOV, we foster a culture of inclusion where every employee is valued for their unique background, experiences, and perspectives. We believe in recognizing talent and providing opportunities for growth, and we are committed to making a positive impact on the communities where we live and work.

If you are passionate about drilling data, optimization, and technical excellence—and want your work to directly shape safer, more efficient operations for our customers—we would be excited to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the main focal point for technical and analytical support across assigned rigs.
Provide daily technical oversight for real-time operations and tool performance.
Generate optimization reports with key events, mitigations, and recommendations.
Deliver operational intervention support on drilling dynamics, pressure management, and wellbore integrity.
Conduct BHA and operational design reviews, trajectory advice, and scope-of-work reviews.
Perform detailed performance and failure analysis using high-frequency memory data.
Support field testing and rollout of new tools, software, and technical changes.
Own the peer review process for technical service delivery and reporting.
Develop and deliver internal and customer technical training; mentor senior operations staff.
Collaborate with client engineering and subsurface teams and contribute to technical publications.

Qualifications

Qualifications & Skills

Degree in Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
Preferably 3-5 years’ experience in drilling operations, including significant exposure to DD/LWD and drilling optimization, or equivalent combination of field and analytical experience.
Strong expertise in drilling dynamics, BHA design, trajectory management, and well integrity concepts.
Demonstrated experience in performance analysis, high-frequency data interpretation, and failure investigation.
Proven ability to translate complex datasets into clear operational recommendations and client-ready reports.
Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams (operations, subsurface, engineering, quality, and software).
Comfortable presenting technical findings to internal stakeholders, clients, and at industry forums; experience authoring technical papers is an advantage.
Proficient in standard data analysis and visualization tools; experience with advanced analytics, scripting, or programming languages is a plus.
Fluent in English, both written and verbal; additional languages are an asset.

About Us

Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.

We Power the Industry that Powers the World

Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success—now and in the future.

Global Family

We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work.

Purposeful Innovation

Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better.

Service Above All

This drives us to anticipate our customers’ needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

About The Team

Corporate

Our family of companies is supported by our global Corporate teams, providing expert knowledge from functions including Human Resources, Information Technology, Compliance, Finance, QHSE, Marketing and Legal centers of expertise. We are structured to provide guidance and service above all to all our business operations.

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.

Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.

Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com .

Role Summary

As a Senior Threat Analyst – Tier I on our Managed Detection and Response (MDR) team, you will provide best-in-class monitoring, detection, and response services to proactively defend customer environments before attacks prevail. You will work alongside and contribute to a team of cyber threat hunters, incident response analysts, engineers, and ethical hackers by using enterprise, log analysis and endpoint collection systems to facilitate investigations, identification, and neutralization of cyber threats.

What You Will Do

Proactively research emerging IOCs, active exploits, and vulnerabilities to stay ahead of evolving threats
Contribute to internal knowledge bases, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives

Provide detection and response support for active security incidents

Essential

Demonstrated experience contributing to real-time incident response efforts and threat investigations

Familiarity with common incident response workflows and security operations processes
Strong analytical thinking and troubleshooting skills, with attention to detail in investigations and case documentation
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
Customer-first mindset with professionalism and a focus on service excellence
Must thrive within a team environment as well as on an individual basis
Natural curiosity and willingness to learn in a fast-paced, ever-changing threat landscape
A passion for cybersecurity, continuous improvement, and staying current on threat trends
Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity or related field, or equivalent practical experience
Willingness to participate in shift work including nights, weekends and holidays (our MDR service is 24x7x365)

Desirable

Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework and its application in detection and response
Experience working with SIEM platforms and managing enterprise security telemetry
Ability to write and interpret SQL queries for data analysis and investigation
Experience with OSQuery and scripting skills, particularly in PowerShell
Relevant and practical cybersecurity certifications (e.g., GSEC, GCIA, GCIH, PEN-200, Security Blue Team L1, TCM Academy SOC L1, or similar)

jobs.title: Information Security Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Clearing House is seeking an analytical and technically skilled Information Security Data Analyst
to support cybersecurity risk reporting, data analysis, and performance measurement across the enterprise Information Security program.

This role is responsible for transforming complex cybersecurity data into accurate, actionable insights that support operational decision-making, risk management, regulatory oversight, and executive reporting.

The Information Security Data Analyst will work closely with Security Operations, Vulnerability Management, Identity and Access Management, Infrastructure, and Technology Risk teams to develop automated reporting, dashboards, and metrics that provide visibility into the organization's cybersecurity posture.

A key focus of this position will be vulnerability management analytics, including the analysis of vulnerability exposure, remediation performance, asset criticality, and compliance with established remediation timelines.

The ideal candidate combines strong data analytics capabilities with an understanding of cybersecurity concepts and can translate large volumes of technical information into clear, meaningful insights for technical teams and senior leadership.

About The Clearing House:
The Clearing House Payments Company L.L.C. is a bank-owned industry utility that shapes the payments landscape and provides infrastructure for safe, reliable, and efficient payments. We see an economy where everyone is connected and a future where modern payments make life easier. The Clearing House operates four payment systems: a high-value wire-transfer system (the CHIPS® network), the country’s first and largest instant payments system (the RTP® network), an automated clearinghouse network (the EPN® network), and a check image exchange network (the Image Exchange Network). TCH also operates a bank account number tokenization service, runs a payments association known as the TCH Payments Authority, and maintains the rules for private-sector check image exchange through its ECCHO® business line.

Key Responsibilities

Cybersecurity Data Analytics & Reporting

Collect, analyze, validate, and interpret cybersecurity data from multiple enterprise security platforms.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical models that measure cybersecurity risk, operational effectiveness, and control performance.
Transform complex technical data into clear, actionable insights for Information Security leadership, executive management, and risk committees.
Identify trends, anomalies, emerging risks, and opportunities for improvement across cybersecurity operations.
Establish repeatable reporting processes that improve accuracy, consistency, and timeliness.
Automate data collection, transformation, reconciliation, and reporting to reduce manual effort.
Support the development of cybersecurity key risk indicators (KRIs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and operational metrics.
Maintain clear documentation of data sources, metric definitions, calculations, assumptions, and reporting methodologies.

Vulnerability Management Analytics

Develop and maintain vulnerability reporting across on-premises infrastructure, cloud environments, applications, and enterprise platforms.
Analyze vulnerability data from Tenable, ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, and other relevant security tools.
Track critical and high-severity vulnerabilities, remediation timelines, aging, exceptions, and exposure beyond established service-level agreements.
Correlate vulnerability findings with asset inventories, business criticality, ownership, and operational context to improve risk-based prioritization.
Identify recurring vulnerabilities, remediation bottlenecks, data quality issues, and emerging exposure trends.
Develop reporting that distinguishes newly discovered vulnerabilities from existing exposure, overdue remediation, and changes resulting from expanded scanning coverage.
Partner with infrastructure and application teams to validate vulnerability data, identify remediation owners, and improve reporting accuracy.
Support vulnerability governance meetings through preparation of metrics, trend analysis, and executive-level reporting.
Develop analytical capabilities to measure remediation progress and assess the effectiveness of vulnerability management activities.

Security Metrics & Risk Reporting

Support the design, development, and maintenance of Information Security KRIs and KPIs aligned with enterprise risk management requirements.
Produce recurring cybersecurity reporting for executive leadership, risk committees, and other governance forums.
Analyze trends in security incidents, vulnerability exposure, identity controls, security monitoring, and remediation effectiveness.
Establish consistent calculation methodologies, reporting thresholds, and data quality controls.
Investigate unexpected changes in metrics and distinguish actual risk increases from changes in detection capabilities, scanning coverage, or data sources.
Partner with Technology Risk and other stakeholders to ensure reporting is accurate, traceable, and aligned with approved risk definitions.
Prepare supporting analysis and evidence for internal audits, regulatory examinations, and management reviews.
Develop historical trending and comparative analysis to help leadership evaluate the effectiveness of security investments and operational improvements.

Data Integration, Automation & Visualization

Develop automated data pipelines and reporting solutions using SQL, Python, Power BI, APIs, and other approved enterprise technologies.
Integrate data from cybersecurity platforms and cloud security tools.
Build interactive dashboards that allow stakeholders to analyze security metrics by business service, asset criticality, technology platform, ownership, and risk category.
Perform data cleansing, normalization, reconciliation, and validation across multiple systems.
Identify inconsistencies between security tools and authoritative asset or configuration management data.
Create reusable datasets, reporting templates, and standardized analytical models.
Work with technology teams to improve data accessibility, reliability, and reporting automation.
Apply appropriate data access controls and handling practices to sensitive cybersecurity information.

Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

Establish controls to ensure cybersecurity reporting is complete, accurate, consistent, and reproducible.
Document data lineage, business rules, transformations, and calculation logic supporting key security metrics.
Investigate data discrepancies and collaborate with system owners to resolve underlying issues.
Identify opportunities to simplify reporting processes and eliminate redundant or manual activities.
Develop quality assurance checks to detect missing records, duplicate findings, incorrect asset classifications, and inconsistent remediation statuses.
Recommend improvements to cybersecurity data models, reporting architecture, and analytical capabilities.
Support continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen the organization's ability to measure and manage cybersecurity risk.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Information Security teams to understand operational processes, reporting requirements, and cybersecurity risk drivers.
Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud Engineering, Application Development, Enterprise Architecture, and Technology Risk teams.
Translate technical findings into concise summaries that communicate business impact and recommended actions.
Support leadership in responding to ad hoc analytical requests, regulatory inquiries, and emerging cybersecurity issues.
Present analytical findings and explain trends, assumptions, and limitations to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Responsibilities

The Asia Pacific, Middle East, and Africa Public Policy team leads the company's engagement with governments, policymakers, civil society, and opinion leaders across a wide range of strategically important markets. We represent the company on high-profile political, legislative, and regulatory issues, and help external stakeholders understand how our products work and the safeguards behind them.

The region spans very different political systems and regulatory traditions, so the same issue rarely looks the same in two markets. We shape and advocate for practical solutions to emerging technology challenges, working toward a policy environment that supports innovation, growth, and long-term business success.

You will take part in some of the most consequential policy conversations shaping the future of the business, with direct impact on how users, creators, and communities across the region experience our platforms.

About the role
We are looking for a Program Manager to lead the design and delivery of policy programs in the areas around our data centre operations in Malaysia and Southeast Asia, and to support our engagement with government, regulators and local stakeholders in Malaysia. You will help make sure our data centre growth brings real, measurable benefit to host communities. You will also build the trust and relationships we need to operate responsibly. The role sits between public policy, community relations, sustainability and data centre operations.

Key responsibilities
1. Policy programs (Malaysia & SEA)
- Own the end-to-end delivery of community investment programs in data centre host communities, including digital skills, STEM education, workforce and technical training pathways, local SME support, and environmental and water stewardship initiatives.
- Develop annual program plans, budgets and timelines for each market, aligned with regional strategy and local community needs.
- Identify, assess and manage implementing partners such as NGOs, universities, TVET institutions, polytechnics, and social enterprises. Lead due diligence, agreements and partner performance reviews.
- Run community needs assessments and consultations so programs respond to local priorities rather than being designed top-down.
- Define KPIs and impact measurement frameworks. Track outcomes, and produce regular impact reports for internal leadership and external audiences.
- Coordinate with country teams and partners across SEA markets (e.g. Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand) to adapt and scale successful programs, and to share good practice.
- Manage program communications, events, launches and site visits, working with communications and marketing teams.
- Ensure all programs comply with internal policies, anti-bribery and corruption requirements, and local regulations.

2. Stakeholder engagement (Malaysia)
- Support the development and execution of the Malaysia stakeholder engagement strategy for data centre expansion and operations.
- Build and maintain working relationships with key federal and state stakeholders. Depending on your footprint, this may include MIDA, MDEC, the Ministry of Digital, MITI, the energy and water ministries and regulators (e.g. Energy Commission, SPAN), TNB, state governments and investment agencies (e.g. Johor, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan), and local authorities.
- Engage local community leaders, industry associations, academia and civil society groups in host areas.
- Monitor and analyse policy, regulatory and political developments affecting data centres, including energy and grid access, water use, sustainability requirements, land use, and digital economy policy. Flag risks and opportunities to internal teams.
- Prepare briefing materials, talking points, position papers and consultation responses for senior leaders.
- Coordinate government and stakeholder meetings, site visits and delegations, and track follow-up actions.
- Act as a local point of contact for community concerns or issues relating to data centre sites, and work with operations and site teams on responses.

3. Cross-functional coordination
- Work closely with data centre operations, site selection, sustainability, energy, legal, HR/talent and communications teams so community and policy work is integrated into project timelines.
- Maintain a stakeholder mapping and engagement tracker (CRM) for Malaysia.
- Contribute to regional planning, reporting and knowledge sharing across the APAC policy team.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s)
- Bachelor's degree in public policy, international relations, development studies, economics, engineering, environmental studies or a related field.
- Significant experience in program management, community development, government relations, public affairs or corporate social responsibility.
- Proven track record managing multi-stakeholder programs with budgets, partners and measurable outcomes.
- Experience working with Malaysian government agencies at federal and/or state level.
- Strong stakeholder management and relationship building skills with sensitivity to political and cultural context
- Business level proficiency in English and Bahasa Malaysia, written & spoken, as the candidate will be required to read & draft documents and communicate with internal and external stakeholders in both languages.
- Commitment to integrity and compliance in all government and community interactions

Preferred Qualification(s)
- Experience in the data centre, digital infrastructure, energy, utilities, telecommunications or technology sector.
- Understanding of Malaysia's digital economy, energy transition and investment landscape.
- Experience delivering programs in more than one Southeast Asian market.
- Background in impact measurement, monitoring and evaluation (M&E), or ESG reporting.

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Would you like to help shape the digitalization of our production environments and play a key role in our extensive MES landscape? As a Business Analyst within the IT Manufacturing team, you will contribute to the further rollout, modernization and optimization of our MES solutions across our factories. Our custom MES solution, Shopfloor Control, is a foundational solution for our Industry 4.0 and smart manufacturing initiatives.

In this role, you act as the bridge between business and the development team, translating needs into pragmatic, scalable solutions that support manufacturing excellence, efficiency, quality and data-driven decision-making.

You analyze and optimize end-to-end production processes together with business stakeholders
You have an active presence on the shop floor to identify opportunities for value creation
You take responsibility throughout the different project phases to implement our MES solution across various plants

You guide projects from analysis through go-live and aftercare
You collaborate closely with the product owner, solution architect and development team to refine backlog items, define acceptance criteria, validate features and support agile delivery throughout sprints

You support local plant teams in collecting, cleaning and uploading master data, safeguard best practices, and ensure data quality
You make MES data available for analytical reporting through SQL queries and collaborate with data engineers and other business analysts across systems such as EWM, SAP and OMP
You collaborate with automation engineers to set up bi-directional communication with machine PLCs
You coordinate change management activities, monitor project progress, and help safeguard scope, milestones and effective cross-team collaboration
You help provide 1st-line support in a rotation system and deliver 2nd-line,with a critical eye for recurring issues, root causes and continuous improvement

Who are you?

Master’s degree in IT, Business Engineering, Engineering, Economics, Logistics or a related field.
Experience with the full lifecycle of implementing MES systems in international or industrial environments is a strong plus
Affinity with agile development and iterative solution delivery, and the ability to work effectively in a Scrum-based product environment
Interest in or exposure to .NET, Angular and Oracle technologies
Strong SQL knowledge and the ability to write queries for reporting and data analysis
Understanding of operational technology (OT), including PLC, OPC, MQTT and SCADA
Passion for how MES systems can improve manufacturing excellence and help plant operations teams achieve their objectives
Experience in an industrial environment, including collaboration with operators, process engineers and production engineers on the shop floor
Strong analytical skills, end-to-end process thinking and a pragmatic mindset, with the ability to simplify complexity and focus on business value
A strong sense of ownership, proactive thinking and problem-solving ability, combined with the confidence to work autonomously and escalate when needed
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage effectively across different levels of the organization and with both IT and business stakeholders
Comfortable preparing and documenting meetings, maintaining oversight, and coordinating effectively across teams and domains
Fluent in Dutch and English; French is a plus
Comfortable working with geographically diverse and multi-cultural teams, and willing to travel occasionally to plants

What can you expect?

A competitive remuneration package.
An extensive leave system and a flexible work schedule with the option of home working.
Luncheon vouchers, hospitalisation and group insurance.
Mobility? We've got your covered! Choose from a wide range of electric company cars, including a charging solution.
Possibility of bike leasing.
We invest in your development and we believe in lifelong learning. In our state-of-the-art training centre The Dive you are bound to find training courses that will help you grow.
Countless possibilities to build your career.
An employer with a transparent sustainability strategy (for our planet, customers and employees).
Our unique Unilin DNA.
In different locations we have a company restaurant with a varied menu.
Benefit from attractive discounts on our products.
Child care is an option during a number of school holidays.
Make the most of discounts at a number of partners through our Benefits at Work platform.
You will often find us at sporting events. You and your family can participate for free.
In short, you’ll be working for a Top Employer!

Who are we?

Unilin is a global reference in interior design and construction with a strong focus on sustainability and innovation. Our floors, panels, insulation materials, and technologies can be found in the homes and workplaces of millions of people and public spaces around the world. Our brands Quick-Step, Pergo, and Moduleo probably ring a bell. Worldwide, around 7,900 employees work every day to push boundaries and innovate. Want to know more about our story? Be sure to check out our website.

Sheriyans Coding School is a technology-focused education organization dedicated to helping learners build practical coding and data skills for real-world applications. jobs.title: Principal Data Analyst - Card Data AI Automation
jobs.description:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems. Capital One’s Card Data Management (CDM)
team is seeking a Principal Data Analyst
with strong problem-solving and conceptual thinking abilities, paired with solid communication and interpersonal skills. In this role, you will be a part of a team of talented analysts driving our AI automation strategy for Card Data. By championing LLM tools like Gemini and Claude, you will help automate complex data validation processes and establish proactive metrics to eliminate operational fire drills. Through this impactful work and a strong focus on work-life balance, we’ve created a dynamic environment with plenty of room for you to learn, grow, and realize your full potential.

On any given day you will be challenged on three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation

Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

Business Intelligence

Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

Data Management

Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

Our ideal candidate will have:

Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
Experience utilizing and developing within AWS services

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 5 years of experience performing data analytics, or, a Master’s Degree plus at least 3 years performing data analytics with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
At least 3 years of experience working with at least one scripting language
At least 3 years of experience utilizing a business intelligence visualization tool
At least 3 years of experience in querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
Proven experience in developing data strategies that incorporate LLM technologies, such as Gemini and Claud
At least 4 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
At least 4 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
At least 2 years of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
At least 2 years of experience delivering Data Governance and Data Quality Management concepts and practices within the financial services industry

Overview

Seeking an experienced, hands-on Project Manager to lead the planning, coordination, and execution of satellite teleport and uplink infrastructure projects across company-owned facilities and third-party sites. This role will manage infrastructure deployments, upgrades, and modifications, including antenna installations, uplink systems, and supporting ground infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings strong project management fundamentals, demonstrated experience delivering complex infrastructure projects, and previous experience with satellite ground infrastructure, teleport operations, uplink systems, or antenna deployments. The Project Manager will coordinate internal engineering and operations teams while overseeing third-party vendors and contractors responsible for construction, equipment installation, integration, and testing. Success requires strong execution, vendor management, financial oversight, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams, schedules, risks, and dependencies. This is a remote role working EST hours. 5+ years of demonstrated project management experience delivering telecommunications, satellite communications, engineering, construction, or complex physical infrastructure projects.
Strong command of project management fundamentals, including scope management, schedule development, critical path analysis, budget management, resource planning, risk management, change control, stakeholder management, and project reporting.
Previous experience managing physical infrastructure deployments, equipment installations, construction activities, and third-party implementation vendors.

With us, you can. Apply today.

Work-life balance

We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.

Your development

Job Description

Arizona State University's GAME School is launching a new Game Studio Production program based in Los Angeles, and we are seeking a Program Manager, Studio Partnerships to help build it from the ground up. About The GAME School

The GAME School in the Herberger Institute for Design and the Arts is a leading transdisciplinary school that specializes in the integration of the human physical experience with computation and digital media. We offer undergraduate and graduate degrees in media arts and sciences with a range of concentrations and an undergraduate in game design. Other program options include collaborations with other ASU schools, a minor and a certificate in media arts and sciences, and a certificate in artificial intelligence and digital media.

Mission

The GAME School educates the next generation of learners and empowers them with technofluency — its development, application and implications. The school prepares students to be socially aware, critically thinking global citizens who strive to bring about positive change in a society that will be increasingly shaped by revolutions in new technologies.

$70,304 - $80,000 annually depending on experience within posted range.

Essential Duties

Identify, cultivate, and secure funding from studios, publishers, industry partners, alumni, and foundations to support student projects, program events, and equipment acquisition.

Develop and maintain a pipeline of internship and job-shadow opportunities with game studios, publishers, and related companies in the Los Angeles area

Support strategic planning, special projects, and reporting efforts led by the Director & LA Faculty

Experience developing internship or workforce pipeline programs
Experience in higher education advancement, development, or program management
Familiarity with game development processes and studio production pipelines

The Herberger Institute comprises six schools: ASU FIDM; the School of Art; The Design School; The Sidney Poitier New American Film School; The GAME School; and the School of Music, Dance and Theatre; as well as the ASU Art Museum and the ASU FIDM Museum. new_jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

On any given day, every moment matters to someone, somewhere. And every moment, Motorola Solutions’ innovations, products and services play essential roles in people’s lives. We help firefighters see around buildings and police officers see around street corners. We keep utility workers connected and visible to each other with real-time voice and data communication across the smart grid. And we provide the situational awareness first responders need when a moment brings catastrophe. We help people be their best in their moments that matter.

Our Deployment team works on the Pronto Digital Policing app.

Pronto is the most popular mobile policing application in the UK, trusted by over half of the UK’s 45 police forces - and used by around 75,000 police officers on a daily basis. Pronto has been designed with and for front line operational users. As a result, it is an intuitive solution, with positive adoption, excellent user compliance and consistently positive feedback.

Based in the West End of Glasgow, we currently have around 100 employees. Our team started as Kelvin Connect in 2002, a spin-out company from the University of Glasgow. Now, as part of Motorola Solutions, we continue to expand with future opportunities in the UK and beyond.

You’ll work as part of an agile squad, taking part in sprint planning sessions, daily scrums and sprint reviews and retrospectives. You’ll have the opportunity to join us at social events like go-karting, clay pigeon shooting or come along for a drink with us after work on a Friday.

Job Description

The Technical Project Manager will work within a squad of other Technical Project Managers, software engineers and quality assurance engineers. As part of this squad they will oversee and share tasks for a number of projects with the other Technical Project Managers.

A Technical Project Manager is a subject-matter expert who uses their technical background to bridge the gap between the product and technical side of product development. They breathe life into a product by enacting the vision and direction defined in the product roadmap.

Responsibilities

Typical activities involved in the delivery of a Motorola Solutions software solution for which the Technical Project Manager is responsible include:

Producing a project plan and agreeing this with the customer
Managing the development and testing of the solution in alignment with the agreed project plan
Deployment and customer sign-off of the solution

This is a hybrid role, where time will be split between our Glasgow office and your home.

Key Responsibilities And Accountabilities

Accountable for the development and delivery of the project delivery plan to a strategic customer or number of customers
Accountable for the development of the business process benefits being achieved by a customer
Responsible for the management of the application development in accordance with the customer requirements.
Responsible for implementation of UAT/SAT in accordance with the test plan.
Responsible for management of the training and deployment plan.
Responsible for the management of the support plan.
Responsible for the in-life technical customer relationship plan.
Develop and maintain the project plan in accordance with customer requirements
Develop and maintain the documentation relating to the business process re-engineering
Manage the development of an application in accordance with the customers requirements
Coordinate the planning of the design and installation of the appropriate technical architecture for a solution
Manage the customer testing phases of a project deployment, including SAT and UAT
Manage the support of the solution once in-life
Manage the issues raised by a customer in relation to a deployed solution
Develop and maintain the documentation relating to business benefits realisation
Manage any third party supplier involvement in project delivery
Develop and maintain all project related documentation
Identify any new opportunities relating to potential sales opportunities

Basic Requirements

Person Profile / Core Competencies

A high level of communication skills - written and verbal
A high level of technical understanding - with the ability to communicate complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences
Diplomacy skills for establishing and managing relationships with customer stakeholders
Well organised and disciplined in approach to work and time management
Must be able to satisfy the requirements for Non-Police Personnel Vetting (NPPV) Level 3

Technical Expertise / Qualifications

A formal qualification (Degree) in Computing Science or equivalent experience
Knowledge of Agile Project management principles - with certification or working towards certification
Experience of managing the delivery of large and complex software solutions to major customers
Proven experience in managing customer requirements

This position is an employee of Stanford University, providing support to the Department of Energy (DOE) contract at SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory. This position requires a personal and professional commitment to delivering safe, quality design and construction performance to support the science mission. This position reports to the Project Management Group within the Design and Construction Services Department of the Project Portfolio Management Office Division.

JOB DESCRIPTION

This position is an employee of Stanford University, providing support to the Department of Energy (DOE) contract at SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory. The Design and Construction Services (DCS) group is seeking a Senior Project Manager to deliver world-class design and construction of facilities and infrastructure projects in support of world-changing scientific research and will be assigned as the CUIR Project Manager. This project manager will be responsible for planning, developing, procurement, design, construction, and close-out/transition to operations of project scope(s) ranging from $1M to $250M. SLAC currently has multiple ongoing projects to improve scientific research capabilities and to maintain existing infrastructure, including backbone utility systems and experimental spaces such as research laboratories, cleanrooms, and associated MEP systems.

The Senior Project Manager also could be assigned to one major project (>$34M) or several minor projects. Major projects at SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory include Department of Energy line-item projects such as the Critical Utilities Infrastructure Revitalization (CUIR) and the Linac Coherent Light Source-II-High Energy (LCLS-II-HE). Minor projects include a wide range of infrastructure improvements such as electrical distribution system repairs and upgrades, cooling tower replacements, roadways repairs and pipeline/culverts repair and replacements.

When serving on a major project, the Senior Project Manager is accountable to the Project Director or Infrastructure System Manager of the major project. When serving on minor projects, the Senior Project Manager is accountable to the Project Management Manager. The Senior Project Manager carries responsibility and authority for planning, coordinating and executing critical project scopes to ensure the project’s mission and program are met in terms of technical scope, cost, schedule and resources.

The successful candidate will liaise with a broad range of SLAC organization groups and stakeholders, including SLAC scientists and physicists, operations and engineering, finance and contracting, facilities maintenance experts and project managers of other systems. In addition, the senior project manager is responsible for coordinating the engineering and design process, managing A/E service design contracts and construction contracts during construction. The senior project manager is also responsible for presenting project information to DOE in Project Reviews, SLAC Project Assurance and Advisory Group [TN1] and regular monthly meetings attended by senior leaders.

Your Specific Responsibilities Include

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

Silvus Technologies is dedicated to one mission: connecting those who keep us safe. We do so by delivering the most advanced Mobile Ad-hoc Network (MANET) radios powered by our custom and ever evolving Mobile-Networked MIMO waveform. Together, our radios and waveform provide vital communications for mission critical applications in the harshest environments from underground tunnels to high altitude balloons.

Silvus StreamCaster™ radios are being rapidly adopted by customers all over the world ranging from the U.S. and Allied Nations Departments of Defense, to International, Federal, State and Local Law Enforcement agencies, all the way to the Superbowl, Grammys and industry-leading drone, robot, and unmanned systems manufacturers.

Silvus’ rapid growth is fueled by a focus on research and innovation and a team of the most passionate, skilled and creative thinking individuals. If you are looking for a challenging experience, you owe it to yourself to learn how Silvus can be the next chapter of your career.

THE OPPORTUNITY

CA,

This is a high-end project management role that goes far beyond passive administrative tracking or simple status reporting. In this highly active, hands-on role, you will be the driving force behind turning high-level semiconductor concepts into structured, executable programs. Your primary mandate is to master the upfront mechanics of program planning— rigorous scoping, logical sequencing, and precise estimation

 Program Scoping & Requirements Definition

Scope Baseline:
Partner with Product Management and Engineering Architects to translate market requirements into clear, bounded program scopes.
Scope Control:
Establish strict change-management protocols to evaluate and approve scope changes, minimizing feature creep and assessing impact on tape-out schedules.
Baseline & Variance Tracking:
Maintain an exhaustive project tracker detailing original baseline dates, revised dates, task owners, and current status.

Identify recurring delays or bottlenecks within the project lifecycle and determine whether team velocity and project health are genuinely improving.

Synthesize detailed, task-level information (which remains in the project tracker) into high-impact, daily health updates. These daily reports must highlight exceptions, risks, and required decisions, and be concise enough for leadership.

Aggressively unblock teams by chasing down dependencies, holding responsible parties accountable, and outlining the exact business impact if a blocker remains unresolved.

Execution & Delivery

Establish and lead core team meetings, phase-gate reviews, and executive steering committee updates.
Risk Management:
Quantify technical and schedule risks specific to semiconductor lifecycles (e.g., IP integration failures, yield issues, tape-out delays) and build robust contingency plans.
Vendor/Foundry Management:
Coordinate closely with external fabrication and testing partners to ensure external timelines align with internal program estimates.

Education & Certifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related technical field.
PMP, PgMP, or equivalent project management certification is highly desirable.

Qualifications

15+ years of high-end project management and delivery leadership experience.
Proven track record of rescuing off-track projects and enforcing recovery plans.
Expertise in evidence-based tracking and executive-level risk escalation.
Exceptional ability to synthesize complex project data into actionable, short briefings for leadership.

Job Description

The North Carolina Department of Revenue ("NCDOR") is undertaking a multi-year, comprehensive Tax System Modernization Program. This strategic initiative will modernize and integrate NCDOR's core tax administration systems and applications, operational workflows, taxpayer service channels, and data structures across five major software release cycles. NCDOR awarded a contract in October 2026 for a Vendor to provide and implement a new integrated tax system. While there is a significant technology shift, this modernization effort is transformational for the agency requiring focus and incorporation of best practices for Enterprise Program and Project Management, Organizational Change Management ("OCM"), Systems and User Acceptance Testing, and End User System Training to ensure successful program execution, quality assurance, organizational readiness, and stakeholder alignment.

Tax System Modernization Program Manager

The Program Manager is part of the Transformation Management Office (TMO). The position reports directly to the Program Sponsor (Chief Deputy Secretary) along with the Technical Program Director and Functional Program Director. The individual leads the planning and monitoring of the program. This role works with various stakeholders on strategic program planning, stakeholder engagement, cross-functional coordination, and program scheduling and resource analysis. The ideal candidate is well-versed in large transformation programs, has exceptional project management skills, and has experience working within the public sector.

Ensure program management best practices are being followed throughout the program, including effective documentation, communication, and change management.

Create and deliver regular status reports, dashboards and Executive Steering Committee presentations and updates.

Develop methods to measure and report on program benefits.

Ensure contractor onboarding and off-boarding happens timely and aligns with resource planning and program schedule.
Oversee technology and service vendor deliverables according to contract and payment milestones.
Collaborate closely with agency IT leads, business analysts, and third-party contractors to ensure effective teamwork.
Manage Change Requests working with the appropriate steering committee or board to present proposed changes and acquire decisions for approval or rejection.

Collaborate with the Functional Program Director to plan activities associated with the organizational change management strategy and plan.
Participate in planning and attend meetings and discussions with external customers impacted by the new tax system.

Team Management

Provide guidance, mentorship, and performance oversight to team members.

Budget & Resource Management

Collaborate with Procurement and the TMO Program Directors on timelines for procuring goods and services to support the program timelines.
Maintain and oversee the staffing plan, ensuring sufficient allocation of NCDOR resources to meet program timelines.
Track completion of contract milestones and payment approval; participate in forecasting future budget needs for the program.

Experience with Agile project management methodologies is a plus.
Proven experience developing high-quality status reports and dashboards.

General knowledge of state and federal regulatory standards for government technology.

Skills

Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact with and engage a wide range of stakeholders.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in project management software (e.g., MS Project).

Requisition Summary

PACCAR Parts is seeking a strategic, skilled manager to lead a team responsible for advancing product data quality and market intelligence. This role combines people leadership with program execution to support parts sales by improving product cross-references, attributes, digital assets, data mapping, and systems integration.

The manager will lead cross-functional initiatives, establish and enforce data standards, resolve data quality issues, and deliver measurable business results. Using tools such as Python, Snowflake, Tableau, and generative AI, this role will monitor product data health and provide actionable insights into industry trends, competitive activity, and market positioning.

Job Functions / Responsibilities

Leads Product Information Management (PIM) system ownership, including product data lifecycle management, system enhancements, and data quality.
Develops and maintains the Product Data Standards Guide, defining requirements for launching parts on e-commerce sites, formatting product data, and ensuring data completeness.
Embeds SEO best practices into data governance rules by establishing and enforcing naming conventions and keyword requirements that maximize search discoverability.
Collaborates with Product Marketing teams and suppliers to improve product data quality.
Creates, monitors, and enforces data quality audits to proactively identify inconsistencies and ensure compliance with established standards.
Monitors data health dashboards to assess completeness and accuracy, prioritizing remediation efforts and enhancements based on findings.
Serves as the final quality gatekeeper for product data, providing analysts with specific feedback to correct errors at the source before publication.
Develops and leverages generative AI to create data visualizations, executive summaries, dashboards, and infographics that provide sales and marketing leaders with actionable market insights.
Monitors industry news and collaborates with global partners to maintain accurate PACCAR competitive analyses.
Leads process improvement initiatives across product data management and market intelligence.
Leads, coaches, and develops a team of product and market data professionals by establishing priorities, assigning resources, managing performance, and fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications & Skills

7 Years of relevant work experience required.
Previous supervision or management expereince required.
Demonstrated experience managing product data lifecycles within a Product Information Management (PIM) or similar system.
Proven track record of designing and executing data quality audits and establishing data governance frameworks.
Proficiency in SQL and experience using Snowflake to query, transform, and validate large data sets, automate workflows, and streamline quality-control processes.
Ability to build and interpret Tableau dashboards to monitor, analyze, and report data health metrics.
Strong understanding of SEO principles, including applying keyword strategies to product titles and attribute structures.
Strong experience analyzing market trends, competitive landscapes, and key business drivers to inform business strategy.
Proven ability to synthesize complex data sets into clear, actionable executive summaries and presentations.
Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical insights to non-technical stakeholders, including executive leadership.
Proven ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented, cross-functional business environment.
Able to travel up to 15%

Preferred Qualifications & Skills

Advanced proficiency in Python libraries, such as Pandas, for complex data manipulation.
Familiarity with regular expressions (Regex) for pattern matching and complex data validation.
Experience using machine learning or generative AI tools for content generation, data standardization, or attribute enrichment.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or related technical field required
Master's degree in Business Administration, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or related field preferred

Competencies

Act with Integrity
Demonstrate Adaptability
Drive for Results
Influence Others
Lead Innovation and Quality Initiatives
Manage Execution
Manage Talent
Use Sound Judgment / Business Acumen

As a U.S. PACCAR employee, you have a full range of benefit options including:
401k with up to a 5% company match
Fully funded pension plan that provides monthly benefits after retirement
Comprehensive paid time off - minimum of 10 paid vacation days (additional days with additional seniority/years of service), 12 paid holidays, and sick time
Tuition reimbursement for continued education
Medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family
Flexible spending accounts (FSA) and health savings account (HSA)
Paid short and long-term disability programs
Life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance
EAP services including wellness plans, estate planning, financial counseling and more
This position is eligible for an annual holiday gift
This position may offer relocation assistance benefits

Salary Range

At PACCAR, we value talent and promote growth and development. We carefully consider numerous compensation factors including your education, training, or experience. The salary range for this position is $119,100.00 - $168,300.00 annually. Additionally, this role is eligible for the full range of benefit options listed above.

Additional Information

PACCAR is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veteran/Disability.
PACCAR Parts is an E-Verify Employer
PACCAR has success with diverse teams of employees working together to achieve excellent results. Having a diverse and inclusive work environment ensures PACCAR has the talent needed to conduct business today and in the future by leveraging different backgrounds, skills, and viewpoints. We believe diversity in the workplace increases innovation, results in better decisions and increases employee engagement.

PACCAR Parts is the global provider of aftermarket parts and services to support Kenworth, Peterbilt, DAF and TRP dealers around the world. This includes 21 distribution centers globally that support 2,300 dealerships and over 1,000,000 customers. Aftermarket support includes world class customer centers that deliver industry leading uptime in conjunction with our outstanding supply chain that delivers record levels of inventory availability for dealers and customers.

PACCAR is a Fortune 500 company established in 1905. PACCAR Inc is recognized as a global leader in the commercial vehicle, financial, and customer service fields with internationally recognized brands such as Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF trucks. PACCAR is a global technology leader in the design, manufacture and customer support of premium light-, medium- and heavy-duty trucks under the Kenworth, Peterbilt and DAF nameplates and also provides customized financial services, information technology and truck parts related to its principal business.

new_jobs.title: Competitive Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Location: New York or Remote (U.S.)

The Opportunity

Varonis is one of the most respected names in AI and data security, trusted by more than 8,000 customers to protect their most valuable data against cyberattacks.

We're looking for a highly technical, deeply curious Competitive Intelligence Analyst to lead our CI program. Your job is simple to state and hard to do: help Varonis win. You'll research competitors, pressure-test their claims, devise winning plays, and build the tools and automation that let our field self-serve competitive insight at scale. You'll be the person sellers pull into their hardest deals, and the person whose materials they actually reach for.

You'll use AI agents to automate much of the CI function, both to accelerate your own research and analysis and to let sales teams self-serve answers in real time.

What You'll Own

Deal Support

Provide tailored, proactive support on competitive deals, addressing competitor-specific challenges before they stall an opportunity.
Develop a deep rapport with the field so you're the first call when a competitor shows up in a deal.

Content Creation

Build the tools that win deals: battlecards, playbooks, kill sheets, customer-facing comparisons, and technical positioning, all written to be used, not filed away.
Produce sharp materials. Clear points, backed by specific, real examples, not a wall of content or vague positioning.

Competitive Analysis

Run quarterly win/loss analysis with product marketing to understand why we win, why we lose, and how to improve competitive conversion rates.
Connect the dots across functions, feeding deal insight to sales, roadmap input and product gaps to product, and positioning and messaging to marketing.

Competitive News & Questions

Maintain an ongoing pulse on the market, monitoring competitor product updates, announcements, and strategy shifts.
Share timely, sourced analysis with the stakeholders who need it, and build compelling narratives, including win-wires, that the field remembers and repeats.

AI-First Operating Model & CompetiBot Upkeep

Own and continuously improve CompetiBot, our competitive intelligence agent, and the automation behind it, so the field can self-serve accurate, sourced competitive answers at scale.
Design, prompt, and tune agent-based workflows that monitor the market, synthesize intelligence, and surface field-ready guidance, freeing you for higher-order analysis.

Who You Are

You're technical to the core. We win in the weeds, so you understand competitor architectures, deployment realities, and product gaps well enough to hold your own with any SE or CSA.

You speak the language of the field, not marketing speak. You understand the sales and pre-sales motion and how deals are actually won and lost, which is why the field pulls you into their calls.

You're genuinely excited about AI, not intimidated by it. You see agents as leverage, and you enjoy designing and tuning workflows that scale your impact across the whole field.

You're a skeptic by instinct. You carry a healthy skepticism toward marketing claims and unsupported narratives. You validate before you repeat.

You're a builder with a bias for action. You have an ownership mentality and a track record of taking projects from idea to execution to results.

What We're Looking For

5+ years in the cybersecurity market, with a strong focus on data, identity, and cloud security.
3+ years of relevant experience in one or more of: sales engineering/pre-sales, field-facing competitive intelligence, solutions or technical marketing, product marketing, or product management.
A strong technical foundation and the ability to break down complex systems into actionable insight.
Hands-on comfort with AI agents and automation, or genuine eagerness to learn fast. We want someone curious enough to run their own experiments and wire workflows together, not someone waiting for a tool to be handed to them.
Proven ability to simplify complex technical ideas into practical, succinct guidance and executive summaries.
Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with impeccable attention to detail and experience presenting to executives.
Insatiable curiosity about the cybersecurity market. You already track its every move.

Why Varonis

One of the most technically respected companies in data security. Our platform protects what matters most.
A role where your job is to help the company win, with visibility across sales, product, and marketing.
A company investing seriously in AI across the go-to-market function, where you'll build the agent-driven future of CI.
Competitive compensation, equity, and a culture that values ownership and impact.

This position is remote with occasional travel to Varonis HQ in New York City and to corporate tradeshows. Regular remote collaboration with colleagues in Israel is required.

We invite you to check out our Instagram Page to gain further insight into the Varonis culture!

@VaronisLife

Key Responsibilities
- Establish and govern reporting standards, metric definitions, and visibility frameworks across LoBs to maintain a consistent source of truth.
- Build, maintain, and continuously improve recurring reporting, dashboards, scorecards, and executive-level performance views.
- Deliver high-impact deep-dives and structured analysis to identify trends, risks, performance drivers, and opportunities for improvement.
- Partner closely with Planning and Performance, LoB leaders, Data Science, Product, Engineering, and QA to align on definitions and data interpretation.
- Improve reporting efficiency by standardizing outputs, reducing manual effort, and identifying opportunities for automation in reporting workflows.
- Contribute to Operational Excellence and Automation by improving reporting scalability, reducing friction, and embedding insight-driven decision-making.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Experience in reporting, business intelligence, analytics, operations reporting, or related data-driven operational functions.
- Reporting Governance: Strong experience in building reporting standards, metric definitions, dashboard logic, and executive visibility mechanisms across multiple business areas.
- Strategic Insight: Proven ability to turn data into clear business narratives, identify systemic risks, and provide decision-useful recommendations rather than just reporting outputs.
- Cross-Functional Partnership: Experience working with Data Science, Product, Engineering, and Operations stakeholders to align definitions, resolve ambiguity, and improve consistency.
- Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present insights clearly to senior stakeholders.

Trust & Safety

Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis. ​
​
TikTok recognises that keeping our platform safe for the TikTok communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining. ​
​
We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person-centred, innovative and integrated approach.​

About USDS

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025.
