Job Description

About the Role

As a Data Analyst at NOV Downhole Broadband Solutions, you will serve as the primary technical and analytical support for our real-time and memory-based drilling services. Acting as a key focal point across up to three rigs at a time, you will monitor operations, interpret complex downhole datasets, and provide timely recommendations that enhance drilling performance, manage risk, and protect wellbore integrity.

You will support Project Managers as an in-house drilling advisor, own critical analytical workflows (from optimization reporting to post-well reviews), and act as a technical escalation point for both internal teams and clients. This role combines deep drilling domain knowledge with strong analytical skills and offers the opportunity to contribute directly to new software solutions, advanced tools, and industry-leading technical publications.

About The Company

NOV Downhole Broadband Solutions is a business group within the NOV Energy Products and Services segment, specializing in drilling automation and optimization through the use of real-time downhole data. By deploying Wired Drill Pipe (WDP) technology and Along-String Measurement (ASM) tools, we enable the transmission of high-density, low-latency data from downhole systems to surface teams. This includes key metrics such as temperature, pressure, rotation, and vibration data, which contribute to smarter, safer, and more efficient drilling operations. As demand grows, we continue to expand our operations and analytics teams to drive innovation and excellence for our customers.

What We Offer

Joining National Oilwell Varco means becoming part of a dynamic, international team committed to delivering outstanding results. We provide:

Challenging Assignments: Work on complex, high-impact drilling and well construction projects where advanced analytics directly influence operational decisions.
Career Development: Access strong technical career paths, mentoring, and opportunities to grow as a Data Analyst across drilling dynamics, data analytics, and digital solutions.
Collaborative Atmosphere: Thrive in an open and informal work environment where teamwork, innovation, and personal responsibility are valued.
Global Exposure: Collaborate with world-class clients, internal experts, and third-party partners on regional and global projects.

At NOV, your contributions make a difference. We look forward to welcoming motivated individuals ready to take their careers to the next level.

Why Join Our Global Family

We are a purpose-driven company on a mission to empower the global energy industry. At NOV, we foster a culture of inclusion where every employee is valued for their unique background, experiences, and perspectives. We believe in recognizing talent and providing opportunities for growth, and we are committed to making a positive impact on the communities where we live and work.

If you are passionate about drilling data, optimization, and technical excellence—and want your work to directly shape safer, more efficient operations for our customers—we would be excited to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the main focal point for technical and analytical support across assigned rigs.
Provide daily technical oversight for real-time operations and tool performance.
Generate optimization reports with key events, mitigations, and recommendations.
Deliver operational intervention support on drilling dynamics, pressure management, and wellbore integrity.
Conduct BHA and operational design reviews, trajectory advice, and scope-of-work reviews.
Perform detailed performance and failure analysis using high-frequency memory data.
Support field testing and rollout of new tools, software, and technical changes.
Own the peer review process for technical service delivery and reporting.
Develop and deliver internal and customer technical training; mentor senior operations staff.
Collaborate with client engineering and subsurface teams and contribute to technical publications.

Qualifications

Qualifications & Skills

Degree in Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
Preferably 3-5 years’ experience in drilling operations, including significant exposure to DD/LWD and drilling optimization, or equivalent combination of field and analytical experience.
Strong expertise in drilling dynamics, BHA design, trajectory management, and well integrity concepts.
Demonstrated experience in performance analysis, high-frequency data interpretation, and failure investigation.
Proven ability to translate complex datasets into clear operational recommendations and client-ready reports.
Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams (operations, subsurface, engineering, quality, and software).
Comfortable presenting technical findings to internal stakeholders, clients, and at industry forums; experience authoring technical papers is an advantage.
Proficient in standard data analysis and visualization tools; experience with advanced analytics, scripting, or programming languages is a plus.
Fluent in English, both written and verbal; additional languages are an asset.

About Us

Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.

We Power the Industry that Powers the World

Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success—now and in the future.

Global Family

We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work.

Purposeful Innovation

Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better.

Service Above All

This drives us to anticipate our customers’ needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

About The Team

Corporate

Our family of companies is supported by our global Corporate teams, providing expert knowledge from functions including Human Resources, Information Technology, Compliance, Finance, QHSE, Marketing and Legal centers of expertise. We are structured to provide guidance and service above all to all our business operations.

new_jobs.description:
About Us

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.

Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.

Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com .

Role Summary

As a Senior Threat Analyst – Tier I on our Managed Detection and Response (MDR) team, you will provide best-in-class monitoring, detection, and response services to proactively defend customer environments before attacks prevail. You will work alongside and contribute to a team of cyber threat hunters, incident response analysts, engineers, and ethical hackers by using enterprise, log analysis and endpoint collection systems to facilitate investigations, identification, and neutralization of cyber threats.

What You Will Do

Monitor, investigate, and respond to alerts generated by the Sophos security stack (including EDR/XDR capabilities)
Lead and mentor Tier I Analysts through escalated cases, ensuring thorough and accurate investigation practices.
Perform end-to-end analysis on suspicious activity to assess scope, impact, and risk
Identify and respond to cyber threats across customer environments using approved playbooks and tooling
Accurately document findings, investigative steps, and outcomes in the MDR case management platform
Conduct threat hunting to identify potential threats throughout the MDR customer base
Investigate phishing emails, suspicious binaries, and behavioral anomalies
Support detection tuning by identifying recurring false positives and suggesting improvements
Stay informed on threat actor behaviors, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and Sophos threat research updates
Proactively research emerging IOCs, active exploits, and vulnerabilities to stay ahead of evolving threats
Contribute to internal knowledge bases, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives
Participate in shift rotations and ensure timely, detailed handovers between global teams
Provide detection and response support for active security incidents
Manage case workflows: create cases, track progress, and follow up with clients until resolution
Engage with clients via chat, phone, and tickets as part of case handling
Assist with developing and refining Security Operations processes, playbooks, and tooling feedback

Essential

What You Will Bring

5+ years of hands-on experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC), Managed Detection and Response (MDR) environment, or cybersecurity-focused IT role
Proficient in the use of endpoint and network security tools (e.g., EDR, IDS/IPS, malware detection platforms) with the ability to validate and triage complex alerts
Working knowledge of Windows operating systems (both workstation and server), with additional experience in Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, RedHat) or macOS environments
Ability to interpret and analyze Windows event logs and other telemetry data
Understanding of core network concepts including TCP/IP, protocols, routing, and traffic analysis
Demonstrated experience contributing to real-time incident response efforts and threat investigations
Exposure to threat hunting methodologies and an understanding of attacker behavior and patterns
Experience handling active threats, including containment, mitigation, and recovery efforts during security incidents
Familiar with techniques such as persistence, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and defense evasion, and able to identify these in real-world environments
Familiarity with common incident response workflows and security operations processes
Strong analytical thinking and troubleshooting skills, with attention to detail in investigations and case documentation
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
Customer-first mindset with professionalism and a focus on service excellence
Must thrive within a team environment as well as on an individual basis
Natural curiosity and willingness to learn in a fast-paced, ever-changing threat landscape
A passion for cybersecurity, continuous improvement, and staying current on threat trends
Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity or related field, or equivalent practical experience
Willingness to participate in shift work including nights, weekends and holidays (our MDR service is 24x7x365)

Desirable

Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework and its application in detection and response
Experience working with SIEM platforms and managing enterprise security telemetry
Ability to write and interpret SQL queries for data analysis and investigation
Experience with OSQuery and scripting skills, particularly in PowerShell
Relevant and practical cybersecurity certifications (e.g., GSEC, GCIA, GCIH, PEN-200, Security Blue Team L1, TCM Academy SOC L1, or similar)

In Canada, the base salary for this role ranges from $86,000 to $143,000. In addition to base salary, we offer additional compensation including bonus eligibility and a comprehensive benefits package.  A candidate’s specific pay within this range will depend on a variety of factors, including job- related skills, training, location, experience, relevant education, certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

new_jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Clearing House is seeking an analytical and technically skilled Information Security Data Analyst
to support cybersecurity risk reporting, data analysis, and performance measurement across the enterprise Information Security program.

This role is responsible for transforming complex cybersecurity data into accurate, actionable insights that support operational decision-making, risk management, regulatory oversight, and executive reporting.

The Information Security Data Analyst will work closely with Security Operations, Vulnerability Management, Identity and Access Management, Infrastructure, and Technology Risk teams to develop automated reporting, dashboards, and metrics that provide visibility into the organization's cybersecurity posture.

A key focus of this position will be vulnerability management analytics, including the analysis of vulnerability exposure, remediation performance, asset criticality, and compliance with established remediation timelines.

The ideal candidate combines strong data analytics capabilities with an understanding of cybersecurity concepts and can translate large volumes of technical information into clear, meaningful insights for technical teams and senior leadership.

About The Clearing House:
The Clearing House Payments Company L.L.C. is a bank-owned industry utility that shapes the payments landscape and provides infrastructure for safe, reliable, and efficient payments. We see an economy where everyone is connected and a future where modern payments make life easier. The Clearing House operates four payment systems: a high-value wire-transfer system (the CHIPS® network), the country’s first and largest instant payments system (the RTP® network), an automated clearinghouse network (the EPN® network), and a check image exchange network (the Image Exchange Network). TCH also operates a bank account number tokenization service, runs a payments association known as the TCH Payments Authority, and maintains the rules for private-sector check image exchange through its ECCHO® business line.

Key Responsibilities

Cybersecurity Data Analytics & Reporting

Collect, analyze, validate, and interpret cybersecurity data from multiple enterprise security platforms.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical models that measure cybersecurity risk, operational effectiveness, and control performance.
Transform complex technical data into clear, actionable insights for Information Security leadership, executive management, and risk committees.
Identify trends, anomalies, emerging risks, and opportunities for improvement across cybersecurity operations.
Establish repeatable reporting processes that improve accuracy, consistency, and timeliness.
Automate data collection, transformation, reconciliation, and reporting to reduce manual effort.
Support the development of cybersecurity key risk indicators (KRIs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and operational metrics.
Maintain clear documentation of data sources, metric definitions, calculations, assumptions, and reporting methodologies.

Vulnerability Management Analytics

Develop and maintain vulnerability reporting across on-premises infrastructure, cloud environments, applications, and enterprise platforms.
Analyze vulnerability data from Tenable, ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, and other relevant security tools.
Track critical and high-severity vulnerabilities, remediation timelines, aging, exceptions, and exposure beyond established service-level agreements.
Correlate vulnerability findings with asset inventories, business criticality, ownership, and operational context to improve risk-based prioritization.
Identify recurring vulnerabilities, remediation bottlenecks, data quality issues, and emerging exposure trends.
Develop reporting that distinguishes newly discovered vulnerabilities from existing exposure, overdue remediation, and changes resulting from expanded scanning coverage.
Partner with infrastructure and application teams to validate vulnerability data, identify remediation owners, and improve reporting accuracy.
Support vulnerability governance meetings through preparation of metrics, trend analysis, and executive-level reporting.
Develop analytical capabilities to measure remediation progress and assess the effectiveness of vulnerability management activities.

Security Metrics & Risk Reporting

Support the design, development, and maintenance of Information Security KRIs and KPIs aligned with enterprise risk management requirements.
Produce recurring cybersecurity reporting for executive leadership, risk committees, and other governance forums.
Analyze trends in security incidents, vulnerability exposure, identity controls, security monitoring, and remediation effectiveness.
Establish consistent calculation methodologies, reporting thresholds, and data quality controls.
Investigate unexpected changes in metrics and distinguish actual risk increases from changes in detection capabilities, scanning coverage, or data sources.
Partner with Technology Risk and other stakeholders to ensure reporting is accurate, traceable, and aligned with approved risk definitions.
Prepare supporting analysis and evidence for internal audits, regulatory examinations, and management reviews.
Develop historical trending and comparative analysis to help leadership evaluate the effectiveness of security investments and operational improvements.

Data Integration, Automation & Visualization

Develop automated data pipelines and reporting solutions using SQL, Python, Power BI, APIs, and other approved enterprise technologies.
Integrate data from cybersecurity platforms and cloud security tools.
Build interactive dashboards that allow stakeholders to analyze security metrics by business service, asset criticality, technology platform, ownership, and risk category.
Perform data cleansing, normalization, reconciliation, and validation across multiple systems.
Identify inconsistencies between security tools and authoritative asset or configuration management data.
Create reusable datasets, reporting templates, and standardized analytical models.
Work with technology teams to improve data accessibility, reliability, and reporting automation.
Apply appropriate data access controls and handling practices to sensitive cybersecurity information.

Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

Establish controls to ensure cybersecurity reporting is complete, accurate, consistent, and reproducible.
Document data lineage, business rules, transformations, and calculation logic supporting key security metrics.
Investigate data discrepancies and collaborate with system owners to resolve underlying issues.
Identify opportunities to simplify reporting processes and eliminate redundant or manual activities.
Develop quality assurance checks to detect missing records, duplicate findings, incorrect asset classifications, and inconsistent remediation statuses.
Recommend improvements to cybersecurity data models, reporting architecture, and analytical capabilities.
Support continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen the organization's ability to measure and manage cybersecurity risk.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Information Security teams to understand operational processes, reporting requirements, and cybersecurity risk drivers.
Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud Engineering, Application Development, Enterprise Architecture, and Technology Risk teams.
Translate technical findings into concise summaries that communicate business impact and recommended actions.
Support leadership in responding to ad hoc analytical requests, regulatory inquiries, and emerging cybersecurity issues.
Present analytical findings and explain trends, assumptions, and limitations to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including querying, joining, aggregating, and analyzing large datasets.
Experience using Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages for data analysis and automation.
Experience developing dashboards and reports using Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence platforms.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, data transformation, formulas, and analytical reporting.
Experience integrating and analyzing data from multiple enterprise systems using APIs, databases, or automated data extracts.
Understanding of cybersecurity concepts, including vulnerabilities, asset management, security incidents, risk ratings, and remediation processes.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to identify trends, anomalies, and data inconsistencies.
Experience developing metrics, performance indicators, and recurring management reports.
Ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple reporting requirements.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in banking, financial services, payment systems, or another highly regulated industry.
Experience analyzing vulnerability data and familiarity with security platforms.
Understanding of vulnerability severity ratings, CVSS, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV), and risk-based vulnerability prioritization.
Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks and regulatory expectations, including NIST CSF, FFIEC guidance, and relevant financial services requirements.
Experience developing executive dashboards and reporting for risk committees or senior management.

Responsibilities

The Asia Pacific, Middle East, and Africa Public Policy team leads the company's engagement with governments, policymakers, civil society, and opinion leaders across a wide range of strategically important markets. We represent the company on high-profile political, legislative, and regulatory issues, and help external stakeholders understand how our products work and the safeguards behind them.

The region spans very different political systems and regulatory traditions, so the same issue rarely looks the same in two markets. We shape and advocate for practical solutions to emerging technology challenges, working toward a policy environment that supports innovation, growth, and long-term business success.

You will take part in some of the most consequential policy conversations shaping the future of the business, with direct impact on how users, creators, and communities across the region experience our platforms.

About the role
We are looking for a Program Manager to lead the design and delivery of policy programs in the areas around our data centre operations in Malaysia and Southeast Asia, and to support our engagement with government, regulators and local stakeholders in Malaysia. You will help make sure our data centre growth brings real, measurable benefit to host communities. You will also build the trust and relationships we need to operate responsibly. The role sits between public policy, community relations, sustainability and data centre operations.

Key responsibilities
1. Policy programs (Malaysia & SEA)
- Own the end-to-end delivery of community investment programs in data centre host communities, including digital skills, STEM education, workforce and technical training pathways, local SME support, and environmental and water stewardship initiatives.
- Develop annual program plans, budgets and timelines for each market, aligned with regional strategy and local community needs.
- Identify, assess and manage implementing partners such as NGOs, universities, TVET institutions, polytechnics, and social enterprises. Lead due diligence, agreements and partner performance reviews.
- Run community needs assessments and consultations so programs respond to local priorities rather than being designed top-down.
- Define KPIs and impact measurement frameworks. Track outcomes, and produce regular impact reports for internal leadership and external audiences.
- Coordinate with country teams and partners across SEA markets (e.g. Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand) to adapt and scale successful programs, and to share good practice.
- Manage program communications, events, launches and site visits, working with communications and marketing teams.
- Ensure all programs comply with internal policies, anti-bribery and corruption requirements, and local regulations.

2. Stakeholder engagement (Malaysia)
- Support the development and execution of the Malaysia stakeholder engagement strategy for data centre expansion and operations.
- Build and maintain working relationships with key federal and state stakeholders. Depending on your footprint, this may include MIDA, MDEC, the Ministry of Digital, MITI, the energy and water ministries and regulators (e.g. Energy Commission, SPAN), TNB, state governments and investment agencies (e.g. Johor, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan), and local authorities.
- Engage local community leaders, industry associations, academia and civil society groups in host areas.
- Monitor and analyse policy, regulatory and political developments affecting data centres, including energy and grid access, water use, sustainability requirements, land use, and digital economy policy. Flag risks and opportunities to internal teams.
- Prepare briefing materials, talking points, position papers and consultation responses for senior leaders.
- Coordinate government and stakeholder meetings, site visits and delegations, and track follow-up actions.
- Act as a local point of contact for community concerns or issues relating to data centre sites, and work with operations and site teams on responses.

3. Cross-functional coordination
- Work closely with data centre operations, site selection, sustainability, energy, legal, HR/talent and communications teams so community and policy work is integrated into project timelines.
- Maintain a stakeholder mapping and engagement tracker (CRM) for Malaysia.
- Contribute to regional planning, reporting and knowledge sharing across the APAC policy team.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s)
- Bachelor's degree in public policy, international relations, development studies, economics, engineering, environmental studies or a related field.
- Significant experience in program management, community development, government relations, public affairs or corporate social responsibility.
- Proven track record managing multi-stakeholder programs with budgets, partners and measurable outcomes.
- Experience working with Malaysian government agencies at federal and/or state level.
- Strong stakeholder management and relationship building skills with sensitivity to political and cultural context
- Business level proficiency in English and Bahasa Malaysia, written & spoken, as the candidate will be required to read & draft documents and communicate with internal and external stakeholders in both languages.
- Commitment to integrity and compliance in all government and community interactions

Preferred Qualification(s)
- Experience in the data centre, digital infrastructure, energy, utilities, telecommunications or technology sector.
- Understanding of Malaysia's digital economy, energy transition and investment landscape.
- Experience delivering programs in more than one Southeast Asian market.
- Background in impact measurement, monitoring and evaluation (M&E), or ESG reporting.

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Position Title:

IT / AV Services

The GST Project Manager
serves as the primary liaison for IT and AV project initiatives, ensuring successful delivery according to defined timelines, budgets, and quality standards. This role is responsible for coordinating project activities, managing resources, tracking orders, leading planning meetings, and maintaining strong communication with clients, team members, and third‑party partners. The ideal candidate is highly organized, able to manage multiple projects simultaneously, and has a strong background in IT and AV technologies.

Key Responsibilities

Coordinate, define, staff, and manage one or multiple IT & AV projects from inception to completion

Develop and maintain detailed project schedules
Lead project status meetings and ensure proper resource allocation
Partner with business owners to oversee project delivery, maintain quality standards, track budgets, and ensure on‑time performance
Prepare and deliver all pre‑ and post‑project documentation
Manage project lifecycle tasks, including planning, scheduling, assigning resources, tracking progress, reporting status, and driving projects to completion
Gather, document, and validate business processes and user requirements
Perform quality checks and oversee quality assurance documentation

Excellent client communication and interpersonal skills
Experience managing IT and AV technical projects

Analytical and effective problem‑solving skills

Competitive salary

Paid vacation
Additional company perks

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Studio Partnerships
new_jobs.description:
Job Profile

Development Analyst 3

Job Family

Development

Time Type

Full time

Apply before 11:59 PM Arizona time the day before the posted End Date.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree and five (5) years of experience appropriate to the area of assignment/field; OR, Any equivalent combination of experience and/or training from which comparable knowledge, skills and abilities have been achieved.

Job Profile Summary

Identifies and cultivates relationships with priority donors and prospects, develops and implements fundraising plans, and works collaboratively with other staff to meet predetermined fundraising goals.

Job Description

Arizona State University's GAME School is launching a new Game Studio Production program based in Los Angeles, and we are seeking a Program Manager, Studio Partnerships to help build it from the ground up. This role is central to the program's growth and sustainability, with a primary focus on fundraising, resource development, and building the industry relationships that connect students to real career pathways. The Program Manager will identify and cultivate funding sources for student projects, program events, and equipment needs, while also developing internship pipelines with game studios throughout the Los Angeles industry ecosystem. This is an ideal role for someone who thrives at the intersection of relationship-building, development, and program operations, and who wants to play a foundational role in shaping a new academic program within the games industry's most concentrated hub.

About The GAME School

The GAME School in the Herberger Institute for Design and the Arts is a leading transdisciplinary school that specializes in the integration of the human physical experience with computation and digital media. We offer undergraduate and graduate degrees in media arts and sciences with a range of concentrations and an undergraduate in game design. Other program options include collaborations with other ASU schools, a minor and a certificate in media arts and sciences, and a certificate in artificial intelligence and digital media.

Mission

The GAME School educates the next generation of learners and empowers them with technofluency — its development, application and implications. The school prepares students to be socially aware, critically thinking global citizens who strive to bring about positive change in a society that will be increasingly shaped by revolutions in new technologies.

Position Salary Range

$70,304 - $80,000 annually depending on experience within posted range.

Essential Duties

Identify, cultivate, and secure funding from studios, publishers, industry partners, alumni, and foundations to support student projects, program events, and equipment acquisition.
Support recruitment efforts for the GAME programs in Los Angeles as needed, in coordination with program leadership and admissions
Develop and maintain a pipeline of internship and job-shadow opportunities with game studios, publishers, and related companies in the Los Angeles area
Build and sustain relationships with industry contacts, serving as a primary liaison between the program and prospective partners and donors
Draft proposals, sponsorship packages, grant applications, and donor communications
Collaborate with faculty and program leadership to align fundraising priorities with curricular and student needs
Represent the program at industry events, conferences, and networking functions
Develop relations with industry partners to ensure alignment of training programs with employer needs and emerging technologies.
Support strategic planning, special projects, and reporting efforts led by the Director & LA Faculty

Desired Qualifications

3-5 Years of experience working within or fundraising for the video game industry, entertainment industry, or related creative fields
Existing network of contacts within Los Angeles-area game studios or publishers
Experience developing internship or workforce pipeline programs
Experience in higher education advancement, development, or program management
Familiarity with game development processes and studio production pipelines

Working Environment

Activities are performed in an environmentally controlled office setting subject to extended periods of sitting, keyboarding, manipulating a computer mouse and using a telephone
Required to stand for varying lengths of time and walk moderate distances to perform work
Frequent bending, reaching, lifting, pushing and pulling up to 25 pounds
Regular activities require ability to quickly change priorities which may include and/or are subject to resolution of conflicts
Clearly communicate to perform essential functions

Department Statement

The Herberger Institute comprises six schools: ASU FIDM; the School of Art; The Design School; The Sidney Poitier New American Film School; The GAME School; and the School of Music, Dance and Theatre; as well as the ASU Art Museum and the ASU FIDM Museum. With programs ranked top 20 and more than 135 degree and certificate options in art, architecture, dance, design, fashion, film, gaming, media arts and sciences, music, and more, plus expert faculty, state-of-the-art immersive media facilities, notable performing arts venues, and national and international partnerships, the Herberger Institute is a powerhouse of art, culture and design and a model of inclusive excellence.

In a rapidly changing world, design and the arts aren’t luxuries—they’re essential. At the Herberger Institute, we harness the transformative power of creativity to solve real-world challenges and shape a more compassionate, connected future.

Our students work across disciplines—combining science, engineering, design, storytelling and the arts—to create solutions that benefit people and the planet. We’re expanding access, removing barriers and providing the resources students need to thrive, because the talent to shape the future is already here.

Together, we’re designing not just new careers, but new systems of care, connection and possibility.

https://herbergerinstitute.asu.edu/
